title: AI Business Systems Analyst
description:
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas – immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and eye care – and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  X ,  Facebook ,  Instagram ,  YouTube ,  LinkedIn  and  Tik Tok .
As part of AbbVie’s Business Technology Solutions (BTS), Research and Development aligned technology team, R&D Global Therapeutic Platforms is responsible for building and deploying scalable Artificial Intelligence (AI) Applications and Platforms.
The Business System Analyst will serve as an individual contributor, working directly with AI applications to support requirements gathering, development, maintenance, and enhancement. This role collaborates with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand complex business needs and translate them into functional technology requirements. The analyst will be responsible for managing application data, monitoring system performance and accessibility, and implementing system modifications to improve productivity and efficiency.
Key duties involve eliciting, analyzing, and documenting business requirements; performing data and process modeling; and supporting change management initiatives. The analyst will also review and route system change requests, develop detailed implementation specifications, and communicate updates to management. This position requires coordinating or conducting system testing, supporting user training and educational materials, and producing reports and analysis from client databases to satisfy user requests and verify project outcomes.
The role is both consultative and technical, requiring demonstrated experience with AI technologies and tools, along with the ability to apply them to relevant business use cases. The Business System Analyst will play a critical role in supporting the evolution and continuous improvement of AI systems within the organization.
Responsibilities :
•Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and procedures.
•Consults with functional areas to develop understanding of the varied and complex business needs supported by the system.  Responsible for determining how changing business needs will affect the system.  Understands the role of the system in the big picture and provides ideas and recommendations regarding the evolution of the system.
•Responds to questions and influences the users regarding current and potential system inputs, processes, and outputs.  Conducts research and analysis into the nature, effect and results of system problems.  Develops detailed business user requirements, system documentation, work flow procedures, and data modeling.  Negotiates plans, time frames and trade-offs while ensuring client understands the final results of the project.
•Reviews and routes requested system changes and develops detailed specifications for implementation.  Communicates system changes and issues to next level of management.
•Ensures current and accurate system documentation, coordinates and or performs testing of system modifications, both validated and non-validated systems.  Provides systems expertise and supports system training, educational tools and materials.  Involved with the Purchasing Systems Manager regarding planning/scheduling and resource allocation.
•Produces requirements for mainframe reports, time lines, and graphics using advanced functions of a personal computer.  Creates reports from existing client databases to satisfy user requests, development of ad-hoc database reporting, data sampling, project analysis, or testing verification.
•Monitors and audits the use of the systems; executes system control practices and purchasing procedures for regulatory and compliance.
•Accountable to the purchasing customer and purchasing management for the control and administration of purchasing systems.  Systems implemented must meet projected timelines and customer expectations.  The incumbent supports various mainframe, Lotus Notes, stand-alone applications, divisional interfaced systems that impact the overall purchasing process.
•Bachelor's Degree and 2 years experience or Master's Degree in Information Systems or related field is required.
•Experience in the systems development, implementation, and operations of a large-scale, enterprise systems.
•Experience with Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models, and their capabilities
•Excellent interpersonal skills and well-developed verbal and written communication skills.
•Must be able to effectively lead and facilitate meetings with customers and technical team members.
•Must be deliverables focused and detail oriented.
•Must exhibit exceptional teamwork skills.
•Must have a strong customer focus.

title: Account Specialist, Urology - Chicago, IL
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. The Account Specialist role promotes a product to community practices and health systems. Customer accounts may include community/private practices, community-based hospitals, academic medical centers, and government accounts (military treatment facilities and/or Veteran’s Affairs Medical Centers). The Account Specialist develops and maintains relationships with various accounts/departments such as neurology, pain medicine, physical medicine and rehabilitation, primary care, and pharmacy. Or in Urology, specialists such as urology, urogynecology, obstetrics and gynecology, female pelvic medicine, ambulatory surgical centers, and reconstructive surgery.
Responsibilities
Promote a product to meet/exceed sales goals in community/private practices as well as hospitals/health systems.
Identify/uncover customer needs (training, clinical, operational, reimbursement) and address with appropriate AbbVie resources
Provide education and clinical/injection training for residents, fellows, and other key hospital personnel.
Expert delivery of anatomical/procedural information and training, including the appropriate use of anatomical terminology to train injection paradigms/postures while highlighting various anatomical and injection insights and considerations.
Effectively utilize AbbVie's sales and data resources to enhance productivity and growth of AbbVie products while implementing U.S. Marketing Plan.
Collaborate with other Account Specialist to promote the product for approved indications and execute individual, department, or group resident/fellow trainings within hospital/health system accounts.
Bachelor’s degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
Relevant and equivalent industry experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree is at least five (5) years of technical experience with three (3) or more years of experience within sales preferred and a high school diploma/GED required
Experience with Buy & Bill and/or Specialty Pharmacy products is preferred, in both health systems and private practice
Ability to lift/pull 25–100 lb. training models and meet necessary hospital credentialing/vaccination requirements
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements
Ability to travel adequately to cover territory, as well as overnight attendance at scheduled training events and sales meetings
Documented history of strong sales performance, preferably in a clinical/technical/consultative sales role with multiple decision makers is preferred. Ability to manage a complex sell, learn procedural, technical, clinical, and anatomical information quickly and communicate/present/train to a variety of audiences
An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements and for any associated liability for failing to do so. description:

The Associate Director, Statistics provides statistical leadership for clinical development and life-cycle management strategies for assigned projects. Specific areas of work may include clinical trials, patient safety, and global medical affairs. The Associate Director works in partnership with experts in multiple disciplines to advance medicines to our patients.
Responsibilities:
Provide expertise/lead regulatory submission and product life-cycle management strategy planning and implementation for assigned projects. Provide statistical leadership for design, analysis and reporting for clinical or other scientific research programs. Independently develop protocols and statistical analysis plans
Represent function/department on project team(s) to provide statistical input to compound/drug development and drive alignment with functional management. Partner with other functions (Clinical, Regulatory, Patient Safety, or GMA) to create development strategies for assigned projects.
Demonstrate extensive understanding of statistical concepts and methodology. Propose novel statistical methodological approaches to design of scientific studies. Provide sufficient detail to allow programming implementation. Ensure that all statistical analyses specified in scientific protocols and analysis plans are conducted appropriately.
Train and mentor staff on statistical methodology and operations. May supervise contract statisticians or junior statisticians. Gain expertise in innovative statistical methods. Assist functional leaders in recruiting qualified personnel and arranging training opportunities for professional development of staff.
Develop strategy for data presentation and inference. Ensure appropriate interpretation of statistical deliverables in collaboration with other functions. Collaborate in publication of scientific research. Ensure accuracy and internal consistency of reports and publications, including tables, listings, and figures.
Act as the liaison for statistical issues on AbbVie collaborative studies with CROs, academic institutions, government agencies, steering and/or data monitoring committees, joint ventures or licensing collaborators. Build external scientific connections which foster professional development and promote the reputation of the Statistics department.
Ensure that all applicable regulatory requirements for work processes are met. Critically review regulatory submission documents. Participate in discussions with regulatory agencies as needed. Validate external statistical software to ensure compliance with SOPs and regulatory requirements.
Minimum Qualifications:
MS (with 10+ years of experience) or PhD (with 6+ years of experience) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a highly related field.
Have strong leadership skills and experience in working/managing cross-cultural or oversea teams
Pharmaceutical or related industry knowledge required, including experience and understanding of drug development and life-cycle management in the regulated environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
PhD preferred
Submission experience preferred
Other Required Skills:
High degree of technical competence and excellent communication skills, both oral and written
Able to identify data or analytical issues, and assist with providing solutions by either applying own skills and knowledge or seeking help from others
Able to manage project timeline and quality of deliverables

This position is located in our Irvine, CA office (hybrid onsite days at Tues, Wed and Thurs).

•    Drive end-to-end strategic innovation, communication and execution on Allergan Aesthetics portfolio + assets in partnership with the R&D + Commercial Leadership Teams. Areas of focus include strategic planning, scenario evaluation, and data-driven problem solving spanning the breadth of drug/aesthetic medical device development.
•    Support R&D strategy processes including: Annual franchise strategy reviews and Strategy Long Range Plans, Therapeutic Area strategy and pipeline reviews, and high priority Asset Strategy Team support. •    Structured competitive benchmarking analyses across franchises, synthesizing external best practices and internal data into actionable recommendations for R&D leadership
•    Rapid-response support to R&D leadership on high importance / visibility priorities.

The Data Governance Specialist supports the consistent and timely operation of the Gov360 governance process across R&D. The role receives, assesses, processes, and triages Gov360 requests; determines the appropriate governance pathway; coordinates required reviews with business and functional partners; and maintains complete, accurate, and traceable records. The position also improves processes, updates guidance and training materials, delivers user education, and partners with subject-matter experts to define and operationalize high-risk use cases and escalation criteria. Responsibilities:
Receive, assess, process, and triage Gov360 requests, confirming completeness, clarifying business needs, identifying dependencies, and routing each request to the appropriate governance pathway or subject-matter expert.
Perform initial risk-based assessments using established criteria; identify requests that may require enhanced review, escalation, additional controls, or cross-functional input.
Manage assigned requests through completion by coordinating stakeholder input, tracking decisions and action items, maintaining status, and following up on open items to support timely resolution.
Partner with Legal, Privacy, Information Security, Quality, Compliance, Data, AI, and R&D business representatives, as applicable, to define and maintain high-risk use cases, decision criteria, required evidence, and escalation triggers.
Maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready records in Gov360, including request documentation, assessments, decisions, conditions, approvals, supporting evidence, and closure information.
Analyze recurring questions, case trends, bottlenecks, and user feedback; recommend and implement practical process improvements that reduce burden, eliminate unnecessary steps, improve consistency, and strengthen the user experience.
Create, revise, and maintain Gov360 procedures, work instructions, job aids, templates, FAQs, decision trees, and other guidance so they remain clear, current, and aligned with approved governance requirements.
Develop and deliver role-based Gov360 training, onboarding, office hours, and targeted communications for requestors, reviewers, and governance partners; assess training needs and incorporate lessons learned.
Prepare and monitor operational metrics, dashboards, and reports covering request volume, status, cycle time, aging, outcomes, escalations, and recurring risk themes; highlight issues requiring management attention.
Support governance program initiatives, system or workflow enhancements, user acceptance testing, inspection or audit readiness, and other continuous-improvement activities as assigned.

Bachelor's degree in law, risk management, or related field. An advanced degree or relevant certification is preferred.

Experience using structured workflows or case-management systems to assess requests, maintain documentation, coordinate reviews, and track actions through closure.
Working knowledge of data-governance concepts, risk-based assessment, data lifecycle practices, privacy, security, quality, compliance, and responsible use of data or AI. Deep expertise in every domain is not required.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify underlying issues, manage ambiguity, distinguish routine from high-risk matters, and recommend practical solutions.
Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple requests, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and interpersonal skills; able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences and influence without direct authority.

The Data Protection Specialist works with various internal and external groups to ensure that AbbVie information security policies, practices, and procedures are properly implemented within AbbVie. They support the Data Protection Office in strengthening company data security controls and maturing operational processes. The individual will interface with a wide variety of people from different internal organizational units, interface with organizational personnel and staff to ensure that the policy is understood by those required to implement, monitor, and enforce the policy. This role is designed for a professional with an engineering, computer science, software development, or related technical background who is interested in the business, governance, and assurance aspects of data security. Conduct assessments of controls to ensure data protection controls are in place.
Leverage AI to analyze volumes of data across File Labeling, Application logs, and infrastructure datasets to automate control assurance.
Engage AbbVie Third Party Vendors to assess security posture, remediation requirements, and compensating controls as they apply to Business Applications.
Develop in-depth knowledge of AbbVie Information Security policies, processes, and procedures, as well as compliance processes and initiatives to provide subject matter expertise and guidance to other organizations (Commercial, R&D, Audit, Legal, Purchasing, etc.) within AbbVie in these matters.

Provide reporting to management on potential Data Privacy risks and planned remediation.

Review current technology and information policies and practices for continued applicability with respect to AbbVie commercial and R&D business programs. Provide recommendations for improvements.
Required:
Bachelor’s Degree with 5 years of experience; OR Master's Degree with 4 years of experience in Information Security, Data Privacy, or IT Compliance experience.

Experience aligning and testing information security controls and frameworks.

Strong project management, collaboration, communication, and organizational skills.
Adept at communicating concepts to diverse audiences with varying skill sets.

The Finance Director, Brand Management & Inventory Governance provides global Finance leadership across inventory planning and analytics, Brand and Supply Chain Finance partnership, inventory governance and controls, U.S. Distribution Finance, inventory risk management, and inventory-related process transformation.

The  Head of Patient Advocacy and Professional Societies Engagement - Oncology  leads the global strategy for building, managing, and sustaining authentic, high-impact relationships with cancer patient advocacy organizations (PAOs), professional oncology societies, and key policy stakeholders.

Experience:  10+ years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical Global/US Medical Affairs, Patient Advocacy, Corporate Affairs, or External Relations, with a minimum of 5 years dedicated exclusively to the Oncology/Hematology ecosystem.
People Management:  Proven experience managing, coaching, and developing direct reports (prior experience leading a team of 3–5+ matrix or direct reports is required).

Competencies: Strong existing networks within international oncology advocacy coalitions and professional society executive teams.
Exceptional interpersonal, diplomacy, and executive communication skills.

Collaborates across the organization to develop and update appropriate content and execution for AA Sales Teams (Facial, SKM, Body Contouring, PRM, and Inside Sales).

20%-  In conjunction with Brand Marketing and Sales Leadership, the sales training leader will focus the objectives, agenda and workshops to conduct effective Allergan Aesthetics Sales Meetings (MM, NSM, Product Launches) and Inside Sales Team Meetings (Austin Onsite).  These meetings will be supported with strong pull through plans across the sales management and field training teams to ensure pull through and accountability of the skills developed at the meetings.

Coordinates National FST and IST programs including annual FST/IST Development Meeting, FST/IST Onboarding, FST/IST Development, FST/IST mentorship in training courses and working with the FSTs in their career development including key projects and preceptorships like the Sales Training Preceptorship Program (STPP).
10%- Effectively lead the development of the Sales Training Department development plan, talent planning and strategic use of budget to meet the development needs of the sales force.
KEY INTERFACES:
Frequent contact with all levels of management and corporate personnel to include:  Sr. Vice Presidents, Vice Presidents, Associate Vice Presidents, Heads of Sales, Area Sales Directors, District Sales Managers, Facial Aesthetics Sales Representatives, Inside Sales Representatives, Marketing Directors, Product Managers, Human Resources, R&D, and Sales and Marketing Managers from other divisions.
Additional contacts with VIP customers which include HCP course faculty.
Main point of contact for outside vendors related to training and meeting engagement technology.
Bachelors degree, (MBA preferred)
A thorough knowledge of Clinical and Business Development in the Aesthetics industry including strong knowledge of practitioners, retail and sales and marketing practices.  This level of knowledge would normally require a minimum 15+ years of related experience (sales and/or sales leadership, training and marketing) in the Aesthetics and or Pharmaceutical/Medical Device market.
Expertise in both Medical Device and Pharmaceutical sales and clear understanding of Avamed and Pharma guidelines.
Clear understanding of navigating and Aesthetics business and experience rolling out programs involving point of sales, patient consultation, patient recruitment and patient rewards programs and a minimum of 4 to 6 years of executing these programs.
Minimum of 15+ years of combined field sales experience and sales management experience in Aesthetics or Medical Device
Minimum of 8+ years of sales training, business training and/or training leadership experience in Aesthetics or Pharmaceutical/Medical Device
Minimum of 5+ years leading leaders of teams to achieve training, sales or marketing objectives.
Marketing Experience in Aesthetics, Medical Device or Pharmaceuticals is preferred but not required

Ability to develop a vision, mission and purpose with a cross functional team to achieve results across multiple objectives and workstreams.
Excellent cross-functional partnership skills and ability to work effectively to drive alignment in a matrix organization.
Strong leadership skills to direct the effective development of entry level to Sr. level skills across the sales organization.
Excellent communication skills, oral and written at a senior leadership level.  The ability to present to various levels and sizes of groups within and outside of the organization.
Proven managerial skills and the ability to work effectively with and through others especially under project and meeting deadlines.
Strong to exceptional planning and project management skills.
Strong analytical skills and a good working knowledge of sales and marketing plans and controls as well as solid computer skills.

description:

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. Our Business Technology Solutions (BTS) team through digital transformation accelerates the future of medicine at AbbVie—and we do it together, asking bold questions and taking on tough challenges through deep, honest collaboration. In the role of  Information Research (IR) Mergers & Acquisition (M&A) Integration Lead , key member of the IR Integration Management Office (IMO), you will join a diverse, global team that invests in your customized career growth and uses technology and data to positively impact people’s lives.
This role represents the BTS-Information Research (IR) organization as the overall IR M&A Integration Lead working directly with cross-functional R&D business and cross-functional BTS teams to execute deal transactions to further grow AbbVie’s Therapeutic Areas. This role performs as the primary IR M&A Integration Lead responsible for planning and executing deals addressing cross-functional dependencies to achieve AbbVie’s desired end-state operating model as we integrate or divest companies.
For anyone who wants to use technology and data to make a difference in people’s lives, shape the digital transformation of a leading biopharmaceutical company, and secure sustainable career growth within a diverse, global team – we are ready for you. In this role, you can expect competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits for every career stage and a commitment to your well-being in the workplace. Additionally, you will add your unique experience to an employee-driven culture with vibrant Employee Resource Groups and a passion for equity, equality, inclusion, and diversity that reflects the diversity of our communities and the patients and customers we serve.

M&A transactions include R&D Ventures, Partnerships & Alliances, Co-Promotion, Co-Development, Divesting Products and/or Sites, Plant Acquisitions and Divestitures, and Full Company Acquisitions.
This is a critical role in partnering with leadership to further define the strategy to evolve BTS’s M&A organization, services, and playbooks for the various types of M&A deals.  This will include cross-functional engagement and leadership across the BTS organization and working with AbbVie’s business leaders, Search and Evaluation, Business Development, and our Transition Office.

​Responsible for escalating and driving risks and issues cross-functionally.
​Present IR updates in IR Leadership forums and R&D Integration Forums

Create AI agents and tools to reimagine or improve a process or capability. Lead and implement multiple projects that drive speed, efficiencies, and/or cost savings.
Effectively influence leaders and cross functional teams without direct authority.
Present BTS updates to the function VPs in the Steering Committees and leadership forums.
Required:
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science, or related discipline with 7 years of experience; Master's Degree with 6 years of experience; PhD with 2 years of experience.
​Respective years of experience leading a portfolio of business applications and leading large, complex cross-functional global IT implementations with strong financial management experience.
​Respective years of experience working on mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and collaboration.
​Respective years of experience with integrating Research & Development systems from acquisitions.
​Respective years of experience with Business Continuity Planning post M&A integration.
​Skilled in leveraging generative and agentic AI to re-image or improve a process or capability. Led and implemented multiple projects that drove speed, efficiencies, and/or cost savings.

​Strong Project Management, Stakeholder Engagement, Financial Management, Business Systems Applications and delivering complex cross-functional global programs.​​

Territory includes: AK, HI, WA, OR, CA, NV, MT, ID, UT, AZ, WY, CO, NM, OK, and North TX

Consistently model “One-AbbVie” and AbbVie Ways of Working Leadership behaviors.
People Leadership and Development: Provide coaching, mentoring and guidance that is consistent and timely to MSLs regarding their individual performance and progress, including annual performance reviews, growth and succession planning, and real time field reports based upon regular field travel combined with data analysis. Ensure cross-functional ways of working with field-medical partners in Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Medical Value and Access, Site Management and Monitoring teams.

Accountable for and have decision-making responsibility for deploying regional resources to support franchise and business initiatives and ensure attainment of medical objectives.
Team Development and Field Execution: Ensures MSLs have the necessary tools, training, and materials to perform effectively. Responsible for identifying and partnering on potential projects that would enhance organizational impact and/or lead to successful execution of therapeutic Medical Objectives.

Communicates regional activities and results to Field Medical Lead and other cross-functional leadership.

​Strong understanding of Rheumatology disease area, clinical evidence, and the role of Field Medical within Medical Affairs.
​Experience in Field Medical, Medical Affairs, scientific or healthcare roles within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
​Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing field-based scientific professionals.
​Experience successfully translating medical strategy into field execution and performance expectations.
​Experience interpreting and leveraging field-identified insights to inform medical or evidence planning.
​Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners within Medical Affairs and the In-Field Team (IFT).​
Ability to travel an estimated 40% of the time.

Leads Field Medical Teams by applying strong scientific knowledge and sound judgment to guide high-quality scientific engagement.
Coaches and develops scientific capability by providing clear direction, feedback, and role modeling of scientific excellence.
Translates medical and therapeutic area strategy into actionable regional priorities and execution standards.
Uses field healthcare professional perspectives, Scientific Intelligence and performance data to inform decision making and continuous improvement of field execution.
Builds an environment of accountability, trust, and collaboration that supports consistent, compliant scientific engagement.
Applies strong people leadership skills to motivate, engage, and retain high-performing field medical talent.
Collaborates with Medical Affairs and Health Impact (MHI) leaders and cross-functional partners to align regional field activity with broader medical objectives.

PURPOSE STATEMENT
The Market Access and Patient Services (MAPS) organization within APEX plays an instrumental role in shaping market access strategies for all of AbbVie’s US brands. As a member of this team, you will lead the planning and execution of standard and ad-hoc analytics to identify/quantify market access opportunities and threats, make specific recommendations on the development of market access strategies and tactics, develop analytical capabilities, enable organizational learning, and ensure alignment of analytical insights with the broader commercial goals of each brand. The role requires strong data analytics capabilities as well as domain knowledge within the overall U.S. market access and GPO environment. The role provides insights that directly impact patient and physician access to AbbVie brands through its influence on the development of contracting and other access strategies.
The Oncology Market Access and Patient Services (MAPS) function supports AbbVie’s US organization and is comprised of highly respected researchers, analysts, data scientists and strategists who are committed to being best-in-class within the biopharmaceutical industry.  We serve as strategic in-house counsel, ensuring that all decisions leverage the key insights that we develop.  We continue to build new capabilities and skill sets, encouraging our team members to pull up a chair, be themselves, be creative, speak their minds, and do good work.  We are a passionate, diverse, flexible, and inclusive organization with a culture that supports the best ideas, wherever they originate.  We are smart, fun, and innovative – and we’d love for you to join us.
MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES
Support analytics and insights on a key oncology brand that influence market access strategy through data analytics, customer insights and business knowledge. Co-develop with U.S. Market Access commercial leaders, innovative contracting strategies to achieve optimal access that maximize net sales for assigned brands. Identify market dynamics that shape brand demand in the channel and build models to portray risks, opportunities, and sensitivities. Leverage data science, strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare landscape and Oncology to identify and proactively address opportunities and threats. Build collaborative relationships with internal U.S. Market Access Marketing and Field stakeholders. Align insights and analytics to Brand analytics partners, that when integrated with HCP and Consumer insights, positively impact brand decision making.
Key areas of functional scope include:
Leading the delivery of brand specific market access analytical insights in response to specific market access issues/trends to drive data driven decision making.
Leading the development of GPO contracting strategies for ongoing businesses across GPO channels through advanced modelling techniques and informing financial projections based on contracting scenario strategies.
Manage ongoing performance reporting workstreams, business reviews and ad-hoc analysis
Understanding the impact of pathways, formularies, utilization management and medical policy impact on overall demand and line of therapy usage.
Identify and recommend process improvements to streamline operations and reduce cycle time and improve quality
Leveraging a strong understanding of syndicated and AbbVie proprietary data, data science and modeling techniques to synthesize insights into compelling narratives.
Managing suppliers and stakeholders, leading external analytics to deliver compelling learnings, and formulate strategies appropriate for the issue at hand.
Leading the communication of market access GPO insights to leadership.
Required:
Bachelor’s degree
6+ years of professional experience.
4+ years of related industry experience in marketing/sales analytics.
Technical skills including SQL, Power BI. Familiarity with Python
Strong story telling skills; ability to distill complex information synthesized into concise and impactful messages and communications.
Preferred:
Master’s degree or MBA
Strong working knowledge of GPO and syndicated pharmaceutical data sources.
Oncology experience.
Market Access experience and Subject knowledge of Community GPOs, Hospital Systems, and Healthcare stakeholders.
Advanced analytics and modeling experience.
Knowledge of Agentic AI coding platform like Claude code.

The Manager of Quality & Compliance (Q&C) reports into the Associate Director of Q&C for AbbVie Patient Services. This role is responsible for overseeing and improving upon established compliance and quality system processes associated with patient support programs, with the primary functional area of responsibility including OneHUB support. This person should be familiar with quality management system processes (CAPA, Training, Audits, Metrics and Monitoring) as well as change management, process mapping and continuous improvement tools. This role will support the implementation of the Patient Services Q&C Roadmap. This role is also responsible to maintain a culture of excellence to ensure a superior experience for partners and patients that will deliver desired outcomes and enable timely, informed decisions.
Responsibilities:
Assist with internal and external audit management for internal, supplier and vendor assessments, and help maintain standard audit process and documentation including remediation oversight as needed.
Collaborate with the OneHUB team on oversight of all monitoring activities for functional areas of responsibility.
Assist with remediation plans for control weaknesses or gaps identified. Responsible for proactively identifying potential noncompliance before occurrence.
Develop and monitor appropriate quality metrics for review by management including inputs into the management review process. Includes the identification and establishment of critical key performance indicators/metrics across all major areas to monitor the health of our systems.
Assist in the Influence of key patient service business leads to implement quality & compliance programs and controls as the OneHUB Q&C SME.
Provides oversight for the development and maintenance of quality programs, systems, processes, and procedures that ensure compliance with policies and that the performance and quality of services conform to established internal and external standards and guidelines.
Support a continuous improvement culture that results in simplification and gained efficiencies throughout the business.
Operate as a key leader in our quality efforts and be the champion of establishing the environment of continuous improvement. Work to integrate the quality system into all that we do, including project management, metrics, and performance review process.
Stakeholder Management: Build cross-functional relationships to ensure end to end quality and manage risk.
Responsible for cultivating relationships with existing Q&C business and governing partners, identifying new partners, providing awareness to key programs, setting expectations, and help influence decisions. Increase awareness and knowledge within the business on quality standards and expectations.
Liaison and Relationship Building: Builds collaborative relationships. Interacts well with diverse groups across business and technology functions and maintains strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators.
Culture: Consistently demonstrate AbbVie's Ways of Working and Leadership Attributes including an enterprise mindset and people leadership. Understand and execute AbbVie's vision, goals, and strategies.
Position requires BS degree in a science related area. Master’s degree and work experience in the pharmaceutical industry preferred.
5+ years of compliance or Quality Systems experience with some leadership experience and a demonstrated understanding of relevant regulations and standard operating procedures.
This role requires the candidate to be physically located in Lake County, Illinois and adhere to 3-day in office ways of working.
This role requires strong organizational, strategic thinking, analytical and reporting skills, and strong understanding of the patient services and pharmaceutical business.
Requires an in-depth understanding of the pharmaceutical patient centricity, customer service oriented, and quality systems.
The position requires human relations and administrative skills necessary to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, co-leaders, and senior leadership in Commercial, Business Technology Services, Legal, OEC, Privacy, Manufacturing Operations, Global Medical Affairs, Promotions, Brand teams, and Global Patient Services.
The individual must possess sound judgment in evaluating and establishing compliance strategic plans as well as in day-to-day situations.
Conflict resolution skills including persuasive management techniques required. · Excellent data creation, storytelling, power point and analytics skills.
Excellent verbal, written, presentation and interpersonal skills required.
Ability to communicate concepts and problems in terms that are understandable to all levels of the organization, including senior leadership.

AbbVie Data and Statistical Sciences (DSS) is the best-in-class organization within its cross-industry peer group and is responsible for bringing people, process, and technology together to generate business value from clinical data. Our operational model is exemplified through execution and innovation.
The Manager of Statistical Programming Operations is responsible for optimizing and deploying business processes and technology solutions primarily focused on Artificial Intelligence adoption within DSS in support of the AbbVie portfolio. A technical and innovative role who effectively interfaces and partners with statistical programming, data analytics, data standards, biostatistics, clinical data management and information technology experts to implement next generation clinical data analysis ecosystem.
Responsibilities:
Lead/Support the design and implementation of cross-functional solutions, business processes, associated technologies and end-to-end agentic AI solutions tailored for specific pharma use cases
Partner with senior stakeholders across the enterprise to identify business needs, translate them into opportunities, and manage project delivery.
Engage with multi-disciplinary experts to influence, elicit, analyze and document business requirements and translate into technology functional requirements. Leverage project management tools and software development methodologies to manage resources, mitigate risk and deliver on commitments.
Develop and maintain automation scripts, workflows, and tools using programming languages and AI frameworks, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant solutions.
Deliver optimization of end-to-end business processes that enable quality and efficiency such as process maps, standard operating procedures, job aids, and work instructions.
Drive change management by conceiving and operationalizing innovation and facilitating adoption across teams. Conduct demos, training sessions, and knowledge transfer activities.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and regulatory guidelines (e.g., FDA guidance on AI) to define future AI roadmaps. Evaluate and recommend upcoming industry trends, best practices and cutting-edge tools. Engage in external vendor assessment and provide recommendations.
Ensure that all implementations meet GxP 21 CFR Part 11, data privacy, and computer system validation (CSV) requirements and adhere to global and local agency regulations, good clinical practices (GCP), ICH guidelines, AbbVie standard operating procedures and functional quality standards.
Minimum Qualifications:
MS in Statistics, Computer Science or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience. OR BS in Statistics, Computer Science or a related field with 9+ years of relevant experience.
Experience leading and overseeing FSP outsourced programming teams.
Demonstrated problem-solving, analytical and multitasking skills with a fundamental understanding of clinical research, statistical programming, CDISC standards and CDISC compliant submission requirements
Fundamental understanding of various programming paradigms, IT system architectures, Agentic AI frameworks
Intermediate-level proficiency in SAS, R, python, shell scripting or other programming languages.
Hands on application development experience using SAS, R and Python
Preferred Qualifications:
Degree in computer science or strong computer science fundamentals preferred.
Matrix Management and Project Management skills are desirable.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and database systems (vector databases, SQL) is a plus
Programming certifications and proficiency in multiple programming languages are desirable.
Other Required Skills:
Ability to effectively communicate complex analytical and technical concepts with clarity, both written and oral to technical and non-technical personnel.
Ability to effectively represent Statistical Programming Operations in cross functional teams.

This is our  MD Fill - Aseptic Gown -  B2 night shift:  6pm-6:30am Wednesday - Friday & every other Saturday
Performs functions associated with cGMP manufacturing operations within the biologics production facility, including working with engineers in set-up and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components and final materials. Uses sophisticated programs (such as LIMS, SAP, automated control systems, etc.) to collect and evaluate operating data, which can be used to conduct on-line adjustments to products, instruments or equipment. Responsibilities
Must have the ability to become aseptic gown certified.
Shipping finished materials.
Maintaining inventory levels.
Sampling of in process and raw materials.
Running glass washer / autoclave.
Buffer / media preparation.

The Biologics CMC Development team at AbbVie in the Bay Area has a long and rich history of biologics development. Now located in a new state of the art facility in South San Francisco, the team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Scientist I role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As a CMC purification development scientist, you will independently design, execute, and interpret experiments to develop robust, phase-appropriate purification processes for drug substance GMP production to enable human clinical studies and eventual licensure. Evaluate novel, advanced bioprocess technologies that are in line with the group’s strategy

Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of relevant industry experience or Master’s degree with typically 2+ years of relevant industry experience (in Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or a closely related field, preferred)

Excellent attention to detail; ability to follow written experimental protocols and safety procedures and maintain accurate, complete, and traceable written records

Demonstrated ability to learn, understand and master new experimental techniques
Able to work collaboratively within and outside of the group
Able to author technical reports and presentations
Has understanding of biochemistry and bioprocess engineering concepts
Strong planning and analytical skills, including the ability to critically evaluate experimental results and identify, document, and communicate significant deviations or unexpected results

The Senior Director, Pipeline Market Access Strategy (PMAX) is a newly created role responsible for leading and inspiring the end-to-end global market access strategy for pipeline assets within their assigned Business Unit. This position will require strong enterprise leadership to navigate the organization through multiple external environment pressures on global pharmaceutical pricing and reimbursement.
This role bridges early asset development and future commercialization readiness, ensuring that pricing and access considerations are embedded from the earliest stages of the drug development lifecycle and through Phase 3 design and identification of evidence needs. The Senior Director serves as the definitive voice of pipeline market access, shaping clinical trial design, evidence generation, and target product profiles through a global access and reimbursement lens.  Importantly this position will need to define distinct US and international strategies to optimize global launch success.
The Senior Director will lead a team of experts across both US Pipeline Strategy and International Pipeline Strategy and will have an opportunity to define the objectives and vision for the team appropriately.  This role will provide leadership across both domestic and global dimensions of pipeline access, partnering deeply with inline US and International access teams as well as R&D, Regulatory, HEOR, Global Commercial Development, Business Development, and Government Affairs to deliver integrated access strategies that position AbbVie's pipeline for long-term commercial and patient-access success.
Key Responsibilities
Pipeline Access Strategy & Portfolio Leadership
Owns the end-to-end pipeline Integrated access strategy for all pre-launch and development-stage assets within the assigned Business Unit, ensuring strategies are comprehensive in addressing evidence needs, policy considerations, pricing potential, and commercial considerations. IASs integrate global needs and dynamics through regulatory submission.
Serves as the primary voice of pipeline market access strategies at Business Unit governance forums, including LMG, TASC, CSM,  ASTs , and other senior leadership reviews — communicating access risk, opportunity, and strategic direction with clarity and conviction.
Serves as the voice of access into pipeline Business Development opportunities.
Leads prioritization exercises across the pipeline portfolio to ensure resources and strategic attention are allocated to assets with the greatest near- and long-term access complexity and business impact.
Creates and optimizes launch strategies inclusive of considerations for IRA, MFN, and other market forces (US Channel dynamics) to position the asset for sequencing strategies across indications as well as geographies incorporating the pressures
Defines and delivers the Access Roadmap— a cross-functionally developed strategy that articulates the access approach for each pipeline asset by development phase, anticipated launch timing, and global evidence deliverables.
Early Development Integration
Partners with R&D and Regulatory teams to embed access-relevant endpoints, comparators, and trial design elements into clinical development programs from Phase I/II onward — ensuring studies are powered to meet payer and HTA evidence standards at launch and partners with the affiliates.
Defines and champions Target Product Profiles (TPPs) from a market access perspective, translating payer value requirements into actionable clinical and evidence generation guidance for asset teams.
Generates and maintains global payer and HTA evidence requirements across major markets (US, EU5, Japan, and emerging markets), ensuring development programs proactively address the evidence gaps that govern access and reimbursement decisions.
US & International Strategy Alignment
Provides strategic leadership and direction to the US Pipeline Strategy Lead and International Pipeline Strategy Lead, ensuring both domestic and global perspectives are fully integrated into a cohesive, Business Unit-level pipeline access strategy.
Aligns US payer strategy, formulary positioning, and value communication frameworks with international HTA, pricing, and reimbursement approaches — creating a globally consistent access narrative that can flex to local market requirements.
Anticipates cross-market reference pricing dynamics, parallel trade risks, and HTA precedent effects, incorporating these considerations into early pipeline access strategy to protect long-term portfolio value across geographies.
Partners closely with US and International Pipeline Strategy Leads to develop and execute a structured pipeline-to-launch transition framework, ensuring that market access strategies, payer evidence packages, and reimbursement submissions are fully prepared ahead of regulatory approval.
Collaborates with US and international commercial, medical, and market access teams to ensure seamless knowledge transfer and strategic handoff at the point of regulatory approval — including payer communication plans, launch sequencing strategies, and country-level access readiness assessments.
Leads cross-functional launch readiness reviews in partnership with US and International teams to identify and resolve access gaps (evidence, pricing approvals, formulary positioning) prior to approval, ensuring no delays to patient access at launch.
Ensures that affiliate and in-country market access teams are equipped with globally aligned value messages, health economic tools, and reimbursement dossiers well in advance of launch — bridging the transition from pipeline to commercial ownership.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Partnership
Provides strategic direction and partnership to cross-functional groups including HEOR, R&D, Regulatory, Global Commercial Development, Global Marketing, Government Affairs, and Business Development — ensuring market access perspectives are fully integrated into all pipeline asset decisions.
Leads the development of Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs) in close collaboration with HEOR, ensuring real-world evidence, health economic modeling, and outcomes research strategies are aligned with anticipated payer and HTA requirements at launch.
Partners with Government Affairs to anticipate and shape the evolving policy and reimbursement landscape, embedding policy risk and opportunity assessments into pipeline access strategies.
Collaborates with Global Commercial Development and Global Marketing to ensure pipeline access strategies are aligned with brand positioning, indication sequencing, and long-range commercial forecasts.
Business Development & Asset Evaluation
Works closely with Business Development to inform the market access potential of in-licensing, partnership, and acquisition opportunities — providing rigorous payer landscape assessments, reimbursement probability analyses, and access risk evaluations to support BD decision-making.
Establishes and communicates access-based licensing priorities, ensuring that pipeline expansion decisions account for payer value evidence requirements, competitive access dynamics, and global pricing sustainability.
Serves as the access subject matter expert in due diligence processes, assessing the payer readiness and evidence maturity of externally sourced pipeline assets being evaluated for AbbVie's portfolio.
Governance, Stakeholder Engagement & People Leadership
Represents pipeline market access priorities at senior leadership governance forums, portfolio review committees, and cross-Business Unit strategy sessions — serving as the definitive voice on access considerations that should inform pipeline investment and development decisions.
Builds, develops, and retains a high-performing pipeline access team, providing mentorship, career development, and performance management for direct and indirect reports across US and international functions.
Fosters a culture of innovation, rigor, and affiliate-centricity within the pipeline access team — ensuring that affiliate launch needs, in-country market dynamics, and local payer requirements are actively incorporated into global strategy development.
Education
An advanced degree (MBA, MPH, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent) in business, health economics, public policy, life sciences, or a related field is required.
Formal training or demonstrated expertise in health technology assessment (HTA), health economics, outcomes research, or pharmaceutical development is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree in a scientific, business, or public health discipline is required as a minimum baseline.
Experience
A minimum of 12–15 years of progressive, senior-level experience in market access, pricing, reimbursement, HEOR, or a closely related pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical function — with a substantial portion of that experience focused on pipeline and pre-launch strategy.

Collaborates with Global Commercial Development and Global Marketing to ensure pipeline access strategies are aligned with brand positioning, indication sequencing, and long-range commercial forecasts.

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. The Senior Manager, Payer Contract Analytics, will independently lead contract modeling and deal scenario strategy for AbbVie's key PBM and payer customers across Commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid channels. This role evaluates contract scenarios to clearly articulate AbbVie’s differentiated clinical value to payers while protecting branded product net price and preferred market access positions.
This role combines expertise in contract modeling, predictive analytics, trend measurement, and financial reporting, and partners closely with Marketing, Finance, field-based Account Managers, and IT. The Senior Manager ensures AbbVie has the pricing and deal analytics needed to secure preferred formulary access at the right cost, managing cost-of-access risk for in-line and pipeline products and setting the standard for contract modeling excellence.
This role reports to the Director, Immunology Contract Analytics.
Key Job Responsibilities
Contract Modeling and Deal Strategy
Serve as the primary contract modeling lead for assigned brands and therapeutic areas with a primary focus on AbbVie’s Immunology portfolio of brands.  Independently quantify the financial and long-range planning impact of national and regional PBM and payer contracts under different market access scenarios.
Lead breakeven projections and gross-to-net evaluations of proposed contracts, identifying the rebate and access terms that secure preferred formulary position.
Lead payer RFP modeling reviews with Account Managers, Finance, and Payer Strategy teams. Agree on modeling assumptions and key sales drivers early to improve forecast precision and speed up bid turnaround.
Evaluate non-rebate contract terms, such as administrative fees, price protection, rebate guarantees, utilization management criteria, and biosimilar step-edit provisions, for their effect on net price and access durability.
Insights and Executive Communication
Turn modeling outcomes into executive-level narratives and recommendations that inform deal budgets and approval decisions. Serve as a trusted advisor, making sure competitive bid responses are evidence-based and reflect current market dynamics.
Monitor payer and PBM contracting trends across Commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid channels, and independently answer contracting analysis questions from senior stakeholders.
Post-Deal Performance Evaluation
Run post-deal retrospectives that compare actual and forecasted financials and recalibrate contract models and assumptions as needed.
Early Warning Performance Monitoring: Track contract performance KPIs (volume, share, net price, and forecast variance) through business-facing reporting tools, and flag accounts that are underperforming against their deal terms.
Contract Analytics Capability Development and Talent Coaching
Advance contracting analytics capabilities with APEX teams, vendor partners, and internal technical work groups. This includes AI-enabled scenario modeling, gross-to-net forecasting, scenario-specific demand analogues, key-driver sensitivity analyses, patient flow and flow-back modeling, sequential response simulations, time-to-event estimates, and competitor brand lifecycle event dynamics.
Manage external analytics vendors to deliver high-quality, timely insights using analytical approaches suited to each contracting scenario question.
Develop and mentor Payer Contract Analytics talent to strengthen pre- and post-deal insight generation that advance each brand's gross-to-net objectives over time.
The individual in this role should have the following background:
Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science, Business Analytics or a highly related field of study and 7+ years of work experience in financial modeling and/ or data analytics in the pharmaceutical, health care or other industry.
Alternatively, would accept a Masters in the same disciplines and 5+ years of work experience in financial modeling and/ or data analytics in the pharmaceutical, health care or other industry.
Strong business and financial acumen – prior experience in pharmaceutical contracting analyses with an emphasis on data and financial analysis is highly desirable.
A working knowledge and understanding of the ever-evolving pharmacy channel stakeholder economics, including Payers, Pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), and Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs).
Demonstrated experience analyzing syndicated claims data sets (for example, IQVIA LAAD or Symphony Health) and formulary status data (for example, MMIT) for Pharmacy channel products.
Advanced Excel/VBA modeling skills, proficiency in SQL and/or Python, and experience building Microsoft Power BI dashboards.
Applied experience with forecasting and statistical methods, such as Bayesian methods, analogue-uptake curves, decision tree models, parametric hazard models, Monte Carlo simulations, and time-series forecasting.
Experience leading market assessments across biosimilar competition, 340B duplicate discount scrubbing on commercial rebate payments, PBM vertical integration fee schedules, and IRA policy impact on Medicare Part D contracting.
A proven ability to turn complex scenario-based analyses into clear executive recommendations that influence market access contract strategy decisions.

The Finance Data Science & Strategy team builds the statistical models behind Airbnb’s top line forecast and explains how the business performs against it. The work runs as a loop. Work with the team’s data scientists to turn those findings into improvements in the next version of the forecast
Communicate findings clearly to partners across Finance and the business, in written readouts and recurring reviews

During your internship you’ll be integrated into a team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. THE COMMUNITY YOU WILL JOIN
Airbnb's Marketing Technology organization builds the infrastructure that powers how we reach and connect with guests and hosts around the world — from audience segmentation and campaign orchestration to last-mile delivery and real-time insights. Our engineers work at the intersection of scale, reliability, and product impact, building platforms that carry billions of messages each year across email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp. We are deeply committed to building AI-natively: agents and LLM-powered automation are becoming core to how we build, operate, and improve our systems.
You'll lead two closely partnered teams that together own Airbnb's communications platform end to end. The Orchestration team builds the systems that let marketing and product teams design and run personalized, event- and list-triggered customer journeys at Airbnb scale. The Delivery team owns the last mile — routing every notification through the right provider, tracking it to a terminal state, and managing contact preferences and vendor relationships. Both teams collaborate deeply with audience segmentation, content, ML, and data engineering teams, as well as product partners across the company.
THE DIFFERENCE YOU WILL MAKE
As the Engineering Manager for this team, you will be the primary technical leader for the systems that decide whether a message reaches a guest or host — and when. We are consolidating legacy and next-generation messaging flows onto a single unified path, moving platform health from component metrics to business-impact signals such as campaign delivery SLAs and burn rate, and building end-to-end observability so any owner — human or agent — can answer "what happened to notification X for user Y" in minutes. Demonstrated AI-native engineering mindset — you use AI tools daily in your own work, have led teams in genuinely adopting AI-assisted development, and have strong opinions about where agents add real leverage vs. hype

description:

The Partner QA Lead is the Airbnb Quality owner for the Elevated Support service tier across a portfolio of Community Support BPO partner sites. Working across partner QA teams, this role makes sure that each site scores interactions consistently, calibrates to the same standard as Airbnb, and turns what it finds into insight that Delivery and Partners can act on.
The Difference You Will Make:
Elevated Support is Airbnb's newest Community Support service tier, built for guests with urgent, complex or high-stakes issues. Cases are identified by an Elevated decisioning model, routed to a dedicated pool of specialized Specialists across voice, async and back-office queues, and supported around the clock by partner sites in multiple regions and languages. Its north-star metric is NPS, case resolution, cost per case, and reopen rate. Because the tier is new, its quality targets, scorecard and evaluation approach are still maturing, and this role helps set them.
The Partner QA Lead is paired with a Delivery (Ops) counterpart: Quality owns the standard, the evidence and the diagnosis, and Delivery and Quality partner on actions.
This is a hands-on, partner-facing execution role and a subject matter expert on Airbnb's quality standards. The Partner QA Lead is responsible for making the Quality program work on the ground: holding partner QA teams accountable, running calibration on the Lead With Hospitality (LWH) COPC form, diagnosing behavior opportunities before the weekly business reviews, and driving actions to address issues and opportunities for guests with urgent, high-stakes needs. The role works closely with the Quality Leads, other Partner QA Leads, Delivery, Training, Knowledge Management, the Elevated Support program team and Business Process Improvement (BPI), and is expected to become an expert in new standards and tools, such as Lead With Hospitality (LWH) QA framework and Observe.AI, and then to drive adoption across its partners.
A Typical Day:
Partner Quality Program Execution
Own the day-to-day execution of the Quality program for the Elevated Support service tier and the corresponding partner sites, languages and queues (voice, async and back office), including weekly QA evaluation targets, evaluation completeness, and coaching activity within your portfolio.
Validate performance data before every business review (WBR, MBR, QBR): confirm that partner QA scores are complete, accurate and comparable, then explain week-over-week movements in a short, clear narrative that Delivery and partner leadership can act on.
Run the Quality portion of each partner's operating cadence: weekly QA syncs, a pre-sync with your ROM/POM before each WBR, and the monthly and quarterly business reviews.
Partner Governance & Accountability
Hold partner QA teams to the Partner Scorecard: evaluation completeness, calibration accuracy, coaching effectiveness and actionable insights. Document gaps and agree action plans with owners and dates.
Audit the auditors: sample and re-score partner evaluations to confirm they follow the standard, and escalate sustained performance gaps to the Quality Lead.
Support new partner site onboarding, language expansion and site visits, making sure each new Elevated Support site and cohort is certified and calibrated to Airbnb standards before it scales, including interim QA coverage by experienced partner QAs while a new site stands up its own team.
Calibration & LWH Standards
Run calibration sessions across your Elevated Support partner sites on the LWH form, including evaluations scored at case level across every Specialist who touched the case, and track alignment at attribute and causal-factor level, so that quality is measured the same way regardless of partner or geography.
Support partner Team Lead calibration, including the weekly sessions that Partner Quality runs within each site, so Team Leads coach specialists in the same language as Quality.
Triage partner feedback on the form and recommend scoring guide updates through the Calibration DRI. Quality owns the standard; partners do not change it locally.
Insights, NPS Detractor Analysis & Escalation
Lead NPS detractor analysis, including the Global Detractor Analysis (GDA) framework, for Elevated Support, where NPS is the north-star metric. Correlate QA results with NPS, reopen rate, AQS and other operational KPIs, and point partner QA effort toward the sites, languages and case types that need it most.
Partner with Delivery, WFM and the Elevated Support program team to establish and refine QA targets and the tier scorecard, using LWH data to recommend realistic, evidence-based targets (for example where sites report they cannot reach targets carried over from volume tiers) and to monitor early-life performance of new sites and cohorts.
Validate the Elevated model end to end: sample cases to confirm the right cases are being identified and escalated to the tier, that handoffs and transfers (including to Premium Support and language queues) work as intended, and that the tier is staffed and routed so guests reach an Elevated Specialist.
Deep-dive repeat trends and build the business case for them. Route issues by type: tactical issues (coaching, site issues fixable with Learning Loft content) go to partner QA teams and Delivery, and macro issues go to OneTrack with an evidence pack, together with your ROM/POM.
Give partner QA teams and Delivery the data they need to find root cause: by partner, site, Specialist cohort, Specialist quartile and contact reason.
Share best practices with other Partner QA Leads, and cover for peers or the Quality Lead during staffing gaps, including language or regional coverage and short rotations.
Tools, Reporting & Cross-Functional Rollouts
Drive adoption of Observe.AI across your Elevated Support partner sites, including AutoQA review and annotation, access and permission hygiene, and the transition from interim evaluation forms to Observe.AI.
Be an expert on every new Quality initiative, such as LWH, Global Detractor Analysis, and Specialist Investigation Skills, and cascade it to your partners with clear expectations, training and follow-up.
Represent Quality for Elevated Support in cross-functional working groups (Product, program management, Knowledge Management, Training, Workforce and Routing) as the single point of contact for your partners, and make sure quality findings that point to policy, workflow or product gaps are raised, not left as coaching notes.
Protect partner QA capacity for strategic work such as deep dives and root-cause analysis, rather than ad hoc requests that are outside agreed scope.
Your Expertise:
6+ years of experience in Community or Customer Support Quality, Operations or a related field, including direct experience with QA programs across BPO or partner networks and experience supporting high-touch, escalated or premium service tiers.
Bachelor's Degree, preferably in related field required.
Demonstrated experience driving partner accountability: running calibration sessions, reviewing partner QA scorecards, and writing and following through on improvement plans with BPO QA teams.
Working knowledge of COPC methodology or an equivalent governance model: sampling requirements, calibration, and objective, behavior-based scoring forms.
Strong analytical skills: able to read weekly QA and KPI data (NPS, CSAT, iSAT, reopen rate, cost per case), diagnose the cause of score movements, and turn it into a clear narrative for Delivery and partner leadership.
Experience with QA platforms such as Observe.AI, or equivalent, including calibration management, form use and review of automated or AI-assisted scoring.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to run a productive calibration session across time zones and present quality findings to senior Delivery stakeholders with confidence.

description:
Some of the most consequential AI work in the country happens where the internet does not reach. As the Principal Product Manager for Mission AI, you will decide what that work becomes. You will own the product strategy for AI capability delivered on one of the largest AI infrastructure programs AWS has ever taken on: a dedicated, accredited GPU environment where strong open-weight and Amazon models are adapted to a national security customer's own data and problems.
There is no established product playbook for this. Public benchmarks, model hubs, and package repositories are not available inside the environment, compute is a fixed on-premises fleet, and the customer's mission needs are still being defined. You will work directly with the customer's technical leaders, analysts, and operators to find the problems worth solving, then turn them into clear requirements that scientists and engineers can build against. You will decide what ships first, what "better than the base model" has to mean before we claim it, and how capability moves from the lab to the people who rely on it. You will also set product direction for the program's infrastructure product manager, so platform and AI capability run as one roadmap.
You join at the start. The lab's first scientists are being hired now, and the decisions you make in your first year shape both what the program delivers and what it is asked to deliver next.
The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for mission AI capability: adapted models, evaluation suites, and the inference and agentic services the customer's engineers integrate into their mission systems.
- Run discovery with customer technical leads, analysts, and operators to find and rank the highest-value mission use cases, and write the narratives (PR/FAQ, strategy documents) that drive investment decisions.
- Define what success means for each use case before work starts, partnering with the lab's science leads to set evaluation standards and the margin a model must clear to count as an improvement.
- Translate mission needs into functional and technical requirements, and make the trade-offs between capability, compute budget, schedule, and accreditation constraints.
- Own launch readiness inside the accredited environment: technical readiness, independent verification and validation, accreditation and authorization gates, operational handoff, and customer adoption.
- Shape future task orders: build the evidence-backed business case and scope for the next wave of mission AI work, partnering with program, contracts, and finance.
- Be accountable for outcomes: track adoption, mission impact, and delivery against goals, and report progress in program and executive reviews.
- Own customer engagement across the service lifecycle: adoption, optimization, problem resolution, and evolution of each capability once it is in mission use. Own escalations on the services you ship and dive deep with engineers to resolve them.
- Influence the engineering roadmaps of the customer's technical decision makers, so their mission systems are built to take advantage of what the lab delivers next.

You start the morning reading the overnight evaluation results with the lab's scientists, checking whether an adapted model has cleared the bar you agreed with the customer for a priority mission task. title: Principal TPM, AI Engineering, AI Engineering
description:
Software engineering is where AI is changing work fastest. Developers everywhere now use AI coding tools, but the organizational gains have not followed, and most enterprises have faster individual developers alongside the same delivery outcomes. AWS AI Engineering exists to close that gap. We help customers systematically build better software with AI across the whole software development lifecycle. AI-native development is now moving from early adopters into the enterprise, and the hard part is no longer proving that it works. It is making it scale.
We are looking for a Principal TPM to help shape how that happens. You will work alongside our engineering teams to bring direction together from two streams of signal: what we learn inside customers' engineering organizations, and where the industry is heading. Customer signal tells you what hurts today. Industry signal tells you what will be table stakes in six months. Connecting the two into a point of view the team can act on, and keeping it current as both move, is the center of this role.
Our current work includes an open-source, AI-native development lifecycle we created and continue to evolve with customers, along with offerings that give AI agents a deep understanding of large codebases and move customers toward autonomous software delivery. Those offerings will keep changing as the technology does, and the charter behind them will not.
Key job responsibilities
Bring the direction together
Work with our engineering teams to connect customer signal and industry signal into a clear direction for how AWS helps customers become AI-native across the software development lifecycle. Find where teams are solving the same problem in parallel and bring that work together, so the organization makes one piece of real progress rather than three partial ones. Help sequence work against customer readiness and keep the portfolio coherent as individual offerings come and go.
Define the methodology, then make it adoptable
Drive the definition, standardization, and adoption of our AI-native development lifecycle as something customers can run themselves. Build consensus on the practices and standards that make it real, and replace fragmented experimentation with a credible default path that fits each customer's risk tolerance.
Own adoption, and scale it
Treat adoption as the deliverable rather than the follow-up, through enablement, documentation, reference implementations, assessments, and self-service paths that carry customers from first experiment to production-scale practice. Design the mechanisms that convert individual developer adoption into enterprise standardization and that let the wider AWS field carry this work without you in the room. title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Amazon Quick
description:
Amazon Quick is the AI companion for work. Today, thousands of enterprises and millions of users rely on Quick to connect their data, understand it quickly, and take action: whether through interactive dashboards, embedded analytics woven into the products their customers use, natural language experiences that let any knowledge worker ask a question and act on the answer immediately, or fully managed tools they build and deploy for their stakeholders. The Opportunity
We are at an inflection point. The way users and businesses manage their commerce workflows is about to change fundamentally. Buying, selling, and operating across Amazon's commerce surfaces still runs on fragmented dashboards, manual reporting, and context scattered across disconnected tools. The convergence of structured data, natural language, and agentic AI collapses that friction: an agent that understands your business, acts across every tool you use, and turns a question into completed work. Quick sits at the center of this shift. We are building the companion where a seller optimizes operations, a buyer streamlines procurement, and a vendor acts on insight, all in plain English, all before the day is over. The same experience, the same governed data, scaling from a single user to an entire organization: not a better dashboard, but a fundamentally new way to run a commerce business.
