Amazon operates the world's largest commerce surfaces, and the next wave of value comes from Quick integrating tightly with Amazon Business, Amazon Sellers, and Vendors so that buyers, sellers, and vendors manage their business inside Quick with full context across every tool they use. Your mandate is to make Quick the agentic workspace where commerce happens, with Quick as the connective layer across Amazon's commerce ecosystem. You will work across S-team orgs spanning Amazon Business, Sellers, Vendors, and AWS, setting direction, aligning priorities, and building the partnerships that make this integration real.
Who You Are
We are hiring a Principal Product Manager, Technical to own this journey. You are a deeply technical product leader, equal parts strategist and practitioner: someone who sets the multi-year vision for a market, influences senior leaders across organizations, and still rolls up their sleeves to ship the next release; who works backward from the customer's deployment, not from a requirements document, and measures success by whether the customer succeeded; who sees a nascent, fast-growing business not as a risk but as a canvas.
Why Join
You will have a direct, visible thumbprint on the companion that is becoming the front door for agentic commerce across Amazon's ecosystem. The decisions you make, about what we build, how we package it, who we build it for, and how we bring it to market, will define how businesses buy, sell, and operate in the age of AI. If you are a builder who gets energy from ambiguity, thinks in systems but ships in increments, and wants to be at the frontier where commerce meets agentic AI, we want to talk to you.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, PXT Central Science
description:
We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive complex, cross-team measurement-science initiatives from definition through delivery. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, can create structure where none exists, and can force-multiply across many teams and organizations to land significantly complex technical programs.
This is a technical program role that demands technical depth in science and software engineering. You will bring strong, data-driven judgment about the statistical systems that power employee listening, using that judgment to frame trade-offs, sequence delivery, and keep significantly complex scientific programs on track across teams.
As our senior technical program leader, you will operate with complete independence across the Corporate, Worldwide Operations, and cross-cutting portfolios. You will drive program delivery where the business and methodological strategy has not yet been defined — working from research questions and methodology owned by science leadership, and orchestrating the science, engineering, and business teams required to deliver them at scale. You will advise VPs and senior leaders on program status, risks, and trade-offs.
Key job responsibilities
Cross-Team Technical Program Delivery
• Own the delivery lifecycle of significantly complex, cross-team measurement-science programs — from requirements and sequencing through delivery, iteration, and long-term sustainability.
• Force-multiply across science, engineering, and business teams, aligning many contributors toward coherent delivery of programs that no single team owns end to end.
• Drive delivery in ambiguous, novel problem spaces where methodological and business strategy has not yet been defined, creating structure and a path forward where none exists.
Science-Systems Technical Judgment
• Bring deep, data-driven judgment about the measurement-science systems that power employee listening — sampling, weighting, instrument pipelines, and statistical methods — to frame technical trade-offs and identify delivery risks. Expertise is expected in measurement science, not software engineering.
• Identify risks and opportunities in measurement-science strategies and the systems that implement them, driving simplification and efficiency across complex, interdependent scientific programs.
• Recognize when a program needs additional scientific guidance and engage science leadership or subject-matter experts at the right moments.
Science Partnership & Translation
• Partner with research scientists to understand research questions and methodology, and translate them into cross-team technical program plans, sequencing, and delivery milestones.
• Independently author accurate, decision-driving documents for senior leadership, including program plans, technical narratives, and launch reviews. Accuracy is non-negotiable: errors in how the science is represented undermine both trust and program integrity.
Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
• Build and maintain trusted relationships across PXT LT organizations, representing measurement-science programs.
• Influence organizational priorities, resource allocation, and technical direction across teams and VP organizations without direct authority — aligning diverse teams toward simple, coherent approaches.
• Manage escalations (is escalated to), proactively driving program and senior-leader reviews that surface risks, opportunities, and trade-offs clearly.
Business Expansion & New Populations
• Drive the technical program delivery required to extend measurement science to new business expansions, including Whole Foods Market, One Medical, Last Mile/Middle Mile, and future workforce populations.
• Ensure new populations are integrated into the measurement framework without degrading existing program quality or scientific standards.
Process Improvement & Automation
• Identify and drive automation and process improvement across measurement-science delivery — reducing manual overhead and recurring effort while preserving data integrity.
• Create, optimize, and drive adoption of cross-organizational mechanisms that accelerate delivery and ensure programs succeed long-term, with or without your direct involvement.
• Actively develop the TPM community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and sharing best practices.
A day in the life
You might start your morning unblocking a cross-team dependency between a science workstream and the engineering team building its data pipeline, then move into a working session with scientists to sequence the delivery of a new weighting approach across several populations. After lunch, you could be driving a program review that aligns three teams on a shared delivery plan, surfacing a methodological risk that needs science leadership’s decision. Later, you present a program narrative to a VP, distilling a significantly complex cross-team effort into a clear, data-driven recommendation. You end the day mentoring a TPM on the team. No two days are identical — the common thread is the combination of science-systems judgment, cross-team orchestration, and delivery precision.

PXT Central Science (PXTCS) is Amazon’s people-science R&D organization. We develop causal inference methods, predictive models, and decision-support tools that operate at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and organizational science. Our work spans employee experience, workforce planning, compensation, talent acquisition, and employee relations — always grounded in rigorous methodology and always aimed at real-world impact.

We set and execute a scientific data collection strategy that underpins listening, modeling, prediction, and insights across Amazon’s workforce of over one million employees — while prioritizing a positive responder experience. Our work sits at the intersection of science, engineering, and business strategy.

title: Security Program Manager, Security Amer-C, AWS InfraSec - VAR
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) serves customers and developers who rely on storage, compute, and our other service capabilities. Our customers trust us to handle their data with strong, continually tested security measures, and protecting that data is a responsibility we take seriously.
AWS Data Center Security is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Program Manager to join our team. AWS provides virtualized infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services to customers around the world. In this role, you will manage complex security initiatives — delivering critical solutions while implementing significant improvements, introducing new mechanisms, and deprecating processes that are no longer needed. You will be responsible for the design, installation, and full lifecycle of physical security systems, including Access Control, Intrusion Detection, and CCTV surveillance systems, as well as overall security policy and program management. These efforts require working with multiple teams within and across organizations.
You will own the overall strategy for multiple large security programs and manage all stages, from concept to delivery, to meet challenging business goals and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience; business, operational, or employee efficiency; compliance adherence; financial results; and other key metrics.
You will also continuously review existing security standards and stay abreast of new industry developments that strengthen the physical security of AWS data centers and colocations, identifying opportunities to raise the security bar and reduce costs. You will work directly with the Data Center Security Operations team, Design Engineers, System Engineering, Construction Managers, Build TPMs, and other stakeholders — both internal and external — to translate business requirements into physical security system design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the design and deployment of physical security packages and program enhancements for the AWS data centers in your assigned portfolio.
The ideal candidate is willing and able to work across multiple disciplines and at all levels: physical security system design and layout, construction and implementation, and oversight of system maintenance and upgrades over the life of multiple projects. You have in-depth knowledge of security technology, are innovative and highly organized, and know how to deliver results on time and on budget. The role may involve travel, and the ability to work autonomously is essential. You can solve ambiguous problems, proactively identify existing or emerging security vulnerabilities, and apply mitigation strategies to reduce overall risk. You understand and effectively apply program- and project-management best practices, and you may be asked to assess processes, program plans, and operational requirements. You work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery, streamline or eliminate excess process, and help teams decouple from dependencies and remove problems that slow innovation or cause customer dissatisfaction.

If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let that stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and have continued to innovate, which is why customers — from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies — trust our broad suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional.

description:
Amazon Advertising is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help define the product strategy for Full-Funnel Campaigns. You will own advertiser growth, running experiments and launching features to drive activation and retention. You start the morning on the growth dashboard. Yesterday's launches came in below trend, so you dive into the data to quickly root cause the change and decide whether any action is needed. Full-Funnel Campaigns make it easy for any advertiser who sells on Amazon to launch a coordinated campaign across sponsored ads, display, video, and streaming TV, with the goal of finding new customers and growing total sales with one budget and one optimization engine. title: Senior Product Manager Tech - Business Process Architecture, Amazon LEO
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we've designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.
Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager Tech – Business Process Architecture to serve as the single-threaded owner of Amazon Leo's enterprise process architecture. Acting as a strategic orchestrator, you will define how Leo's manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and operational processes move from their current "as-is" state to a deliberately designed, governed, and measurable "to-be" state. You will own the enterprise process methodology toolbox and apply the right method to each problem rather than forcing a single framework, using process mining, simulation, and data-driven discovery to replace opinion with objective insight.
This role spans the full enterprise process-architecture competency set. On the transformational side, you will build the business case and vision, communicate it, and lead the organizational change required to make process transformation stick. On the operational side, you will discover formal and informal processes, model and analyze them, design improved target states, and establish the governance model, process policies, and performance management that link process inputs and outputs to business outcomes. On the technical side, you will translate target processes into solution architecture, applying agile and model-driven delivery and designing for usability — realizing business goals through a clear understanding of the business, information, and technical architectures.
You will be the connective tissue across Leo's enterprise application landscape, with a deep focus on ERP (SAP S/4HANA) and PLM (Teamcenter) and their integration with the broader estate — MES, supply chain planning, and quality systems. You will define integration and data-flow patterns, protect master-data integrity across the digital thread, and ensure that process designs are feasible, adoptable, and durable before resources are committed.
Key job responsibilities
- Build the business case and vision for process transformation, articulating alignment with business strategy and demonstrating value through operations and process metrics for ROI and system investment.
- Author OP1/OP2 narratives.
- Apply project management principles to drive transformation, balancing constraints against desired outcomes.
- Communicate transformation goals, benefits, and successes to gain stakeholder support, and apply change management to overcome resistance to process change.
- Lead business process discovery to identify formal and informal processes and understand the "as-is" state.
- Model, analyze, and design processes — visually depicting them to assess impact and design improved "to-be" states.
- Partner with manufacturing, supply chain, quality, finance, IT, and engineering leadership to elicit requirements, build consensus, and resolve competing priorities.
- Own process performance management, linking process inputs and outputs to business performance to identify improvement areas.
- Deliver solution architecture and design across ERP (SAP S/4HANA), PLM (Teamcenter), and the broader enterprise estate — realizing business goals through business, information, and technical architectures.
- Use agile and model-driven development to rapidly deliver process improvements.
- Apply process optimization and simulation to test the impact of changes before implementation.
- Analyze user interactions with processes to improve usability.
About the team
Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience working cross-functionally with a wide breadth of stakeholders, users, engineers, and leaders to generate buy-in
- Bachelor's degree in Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or another technical field
- Experience with solution architecture and integration across enterprise applications, with depth in ERP (SAP S/4HANA) and PLM (Teamcenter), including their integration with MES, supply chain planning, and quality systems.
Preferred qualifications: - Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree in engineering, management, or technology

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, OpsTech Solutions, OTS Delivery Software Engineering (DSE)
description:
Every Amazon package that ships, every grocery order that is fulfilled, and every associate who needs IT help depends on technology our teams keep running. Amazon's OpsTech Solutions (OTS) is the IT operations and infrastructure organization for all of Amazon Worldwide Operations, including Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS), delivering reliable technology to more than one million associates and operators across every geography. OTS is transforming from reactive support to proactive, prescriptive, AI-powered service delivery, and ServiceNow is the platform where that work happens.
What this role is: You will own the product strategy for the OTS Incident Management Platform (ITSM), the core system of record and orchestration layer for how the organization receives, records, routes, and resolves work. Every requester contact, Service Desk interaction, and Field IT task flows through the incident record you own. You decide what gets built, what gets retired, and how ITSM becomes the foundation that the rest of the OTS product portfolio plugs into.
Our team is organized around three questions that apply to every persona we serve: How does someone ask for help? How does the organization receive and organize that work? How does the work get resolved? This role owns the center of that model. Your peers own the requester front door (OneSupportHub and Virtual Agent), Service Desk Workforce Optimization, AI resolution intelligence (OTS Assist and PathFinder), and Field IT productivity. ITSM is where all of those come together on a single record, so the decisions you make shape how well every adjacent product works.
The opportunity is to move ITSM from a place where fulfillers log work to a platform that actively guides it. Today, Service Desk fulfillers and Field IT technicians lose time to platform friction and assemble each resolution themselves from memory and scattered knowledge. You will turn ITSM into the orchestrator that brings AI-generated resolution plans, validated data, and trusted knowledge into the fulfiller's workflow, so the right next step is the obvious one. Your customers are Service Desk fulfillers, Field IT technicians and managers, knowledge authors, and the engineers who integrate other services with the incident record.
Key Highlights
• Own the product strategy and roadmap for the OTS Incident Management Platform (ITSM), the system of record and orchestration layer for OTS work.
• Drive the reactive-to-prescriptive transformation by making ITSM the place where AI-generated resolution plans become the default way to work an incident.
• Lead Knowledge Base improvements so content is easy to find, trustworthy, and measured.
• Work at the center of a product team whose adjacent products (intake, routing, workforce optimization, AI resolution) all depend on your platform.
Key job responsibilities
- Define and own a multi-year product vision and roadmap for ITSM, covering incident and task management, orchestration and validation, ITSM user experience, and Knowledge Management.
- Act as the voice of the customer for Service Desk and Field IT, using shadowing, feedback, and operational data to translate real workflow friction into prioritized requirements.
- Partner with the AI resolution product team to deliver prescriptive, guided resolution on the incident record, and own the fulfiller-facing experience and its adoption.
- Set clear ownership boundaries and integration contracts between ITSM and adjacent products (intake, routing, workforce optimization, AI agents) so teams build on the platform rather than around it.
- Partner with engineering leaders to shape platform architecture, drive build-vs-configure-vs-buy decisions on ServiceNow, and manage platform health and technical debt.
- Establish north-star and adoption metrics for the platform (e.g., handle time, resolution-plan adoption, documentation quality, knowledge reuse) and report on them through Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews.
- Contribute to annual planning mechanisms (OP1/OP2) with clear, well-reasoned investment proposals, and maintain mechanisms to continuously capture voice of the customer.
A day in the life
Your day moves between the floor and the roadmap. You might start by shadowing IT technicians to see where a knowledge article pulls them off a ticket or where a chat times out mid-conversation, then turn those observations into user stories with your engineering partners. Midday, you join an architecture discussion on how AI-generated resolution plans write back to the incident record and where that boundary sits with the AI team. In the afternoon, you review adoption metrics, make prioritization trade-offs with stakeholders across the IT organization, and draft a strategy narrative or OP2 investment proposal for senior review.
About the team
The ServiceNow Product Management team builds the products that are the backbone of OTS operations. Amazon employees, Service Desk agents, and Field IT technicians rely on these ServiceNow experiences to complete their work every day. The team is a group of Product Managers, each owning one clear product space so they can go deep instead of switching between unrelated problems, supported by a dedicated UX designer. Your engineering counterparts sit within the same larger organization, and your primary stakeholders are the Service Desk and Field IT organizations.

title: AI Research Scientist: Multimodal Foundation Models - Architecture, Pre-Training & Distillation
description:
The Multimodal Intelligence Team is building the next generation of foundation models for Apple experiences. We are looking for a research scientist to advance the architectures, pre-training methods, and distillation techniques that make highly capable multimodal models practical across the Apple ecosystem.
Our research spans the full foundation-model lifecycle: model architecture, pre-training objectives, data mixtures, optimization, scaling, distillation, and evaluation. A defining challenge of our work is to develop models that combine broad intelligence with the memory, latency, energy, and privacy requirements of on-device deployment.
You will have the opportunity to shape new research directions, conduct ambitious experiments at scale, and translate successful ideas into foundation-model technologies that can reach Apple products. Where appropriate, this work may also lead to publications and the open sourcing of selected models, research artifacts, evaluations, or tools.
In this role, you will investigate fundamental questions about how multimodal foundation models should be designed, trained, and distilled.
You will develop and evaluate new model architectures, pre-training objectives, data strategies, optimization methods, and teacher–student learning techniques. Your work will explore how capabilities developed in large foundation models can be effectively transferred to smaller, more efficient models without treating distillation as an isolated downstream step.
A major focus of the role will be the co-development of frontier models and efficient models for Apple silicon and on-device intelligence. This includes designing architectures that distill effectively, studying how teacher and student models should be trained together, and developing distillation methods that preserve reasoning, multimodal understanding, instruction following, and other important capabilities under constrained model capacity.
Rather than treating deployment constraints as an afterthought, you will incorporate them into the research process—from early architecture experiments and pre-training through distillation and final model evaluation.
You may thrive in this role if you:
* Want to invent new foundation-model architectures rather than only adapt existing models.
* Enjoy combining scientific ambition with real compute, memory, latency, and energy constraints.
* Believe that small and efficient models can be a frontier research problem, not merely a compression exercise.
* Are comfortable working across model research, data, systems, and hardware boundaries.
* Care about translating research into private, useful, and deeply integrated intelligent experiences.
* Want your work to have both product impact and a presence in the broader research community.
Potential research directions include:
* Novel dense, recurrent, state-space, mixture-of-experts, and hybrid foundation-model architectures.
* Multimodal pre-training across language, images, video, audio, and sensor-derived representations.
* Compute-optimal model and data scaling, including data mixtures, curricula, tokenization, and training objectives.
* Architecture and algorithm co-design for memory-efficient and energy-efficient inference on Apple silicon.
* Offline and on-policy distillation using teacher-generated data, logits, representations, rationales, and other supervision signals.
Minimum qualifications: Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and running large-scale pre-training experiments for large language models.
Experience with LLM pre-training topics such as model architecture, training objectives, data mixtures, tokenization, curricula, scaling, and optimization.
Strong proficiency with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX and distributed training systems.
Experience evaluating pre-trained models across language understanding, reasoning, instruction following, or multimodal capabilities.
Strong understanding of transformer-based architectures and current approaches to efficient or scalable foundation-model training.
Master’s degree, or equivalent practical experience in machine learning, computer science, or a related technical field, and a minimum of 6 years relevant experience.
Preferred qualifications: Experience contributing to major foundation-model pre-training efforts or leading architecture experiments that influenced a large training run.
Research contributions in model architecture, scaling laws, multimodal pre-training, optimization, efficient attention, mixture-of-experts, state-space models, or related areas.
Experience with knowledge distillation, including offline or off-policy distillation, on-policy distillation, self-distillation, sequence-level distillation, logic matching, or representation transfer.
Experience designing teacher–student training pipelines or transferring capabilities from large foundation models to smaller models.
Experience with multimodal models spanning language, vision, video, audio, or other sensor modalities.
Understanding of inference efficiency, memory hierarchy, hardware accelerators, or hardware–software co-design.
Strong publication record, influential open-source contributions, or an equivalent record of applied research impact

The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it!
The Apple US Business team is responsible for building a balanced and scalable business that delivers tangible benefits to the end-customers. We believe the outstanding combination of portability, user experience, and data privacy and security, made possible through Apple’s coordinated hardware and software platform, delivers the best solutions for our customers. We are here to help enterprise businesses transform the way people work while growing top-line revenue for Apple. To realize this goal, we gain deep understandings of the businesses we manage at all levels, from tactical to strategic. We build a vision that can encourage customers to transform using Apple products. We collaborate closely with internal and external partners to build plans for solutions and new use cases, and then we help drive execution of the solution!
In this role, you will:
Deeply understand your assigned account’s business models by researching and exploring an ever-expanding group of contacts.
You will develop account plans aligned with our customers’ strategies, assess their progress, and guide them on the journey of transformation to mobility and growing adoption of the Apple ecosystem.
Effectively execute on plans by cross-functionally partnering with Systems Engineers, industry specialists, as well as reseller and strategic partners. You’ll build demand generation activities, identify new opportunities, accurately forecast, and coordinate fulfillment logistics.
Minimum qualifications: Approximately 8 years of experience as an Account Executive selling to large Enterprises.
Validated consultative selling experience in business transformation solutions for large enterprises that balanced delivering on short-term goals, while crafting sustainable value for customers and demand for the future.
Experience in cultivating C-level executive relationships at Fortune 500 companies.
Comfortable challenging the status quo.
Can demonstrate previous success with executive interaction.
Strengths in relationship development/management, teaming across functions, deal making, and negotiations.
A strong self-starter who is able to work independently to develop new areas with the ability to work in a dynamic, sometimes ambiguous environment.
Up to 50% domestic travel required.
Preferred qualifications: No matter the audience, you are very good at presenting. And, you’re cool under pressure. You make the complex simple and you command an audience by bringing them along for the journey. You support others to learn, to be curious, and ultimately, share your passion for the Apple story. When challenged with complex questions, you share your deep knowledge of how our hardware, software, and services integrate.
You understand there are many moving parts in an organization. Navigating the interdependencies within Apple is needed for success. Understanding how business financials work and strategies for sustaining profitable growth are key to staying ahead of the competition. You analyze the market and think beyond the short term.
Apple doesn’t cut corners, in products or in business. You bring the highest level of integrity, honesty, and accountability in all that you do, every single day. You are a trusted advisor who does what you say you’ll do – and always does what’s best for Apple.
You see the world through the eyes of the customer by deeply understanding their business needs, challenges, and concerns. At Apple, we obsess over how people experience our products and services. You not only meet our customers’ expectations but exceed them. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

title: Apple TV Growth Operations Manager
description:
The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Our team is responsible for Apple TV streaming, driving overall revenue as well as subscriber growth for Apple TV, curating and managing the app experience, programming and editorializing while striving to acquire, engage and retain subscribers for Apple TV and our partners.
We are seeking an experienced, analytical, and entrepreneurial individual to help significantly grow our first party video streaming subscription services. As a TV Growth Operations Manager, you will play a pivotal role in operationalizing and scaling strategic TV initiatives, including bundles and other strategic projects, directly contributing to the growth of Apple's video subscription business. You will be the linchpin in ensuring the seamless execution and ongoing success of complex multi-service offerings. The role requires a highly-motivated and adaptive self-stater willing to jump straight in and work with multiple internal and external teams to meet goals. You should have a proven track record of building and managing successful video streaming and bundling programs and project integration and have a deep understanding of the digital video and streaming space.
Minimum qualifications: 7+ years of meaningful experience in media and/or digital video streaming/ subscription services
Consistent record of successfully managing complex business and technical programs with both 3rd parties and cross-functionally within a global organization
Strong analytical skills, confident translating metrics into actionable insights for subscription growth
Deep understanding of subscription services and bundles, complex commercial deal structure, and streaming partnerships landscape
Direct experience in growing video streaming business and managing growth programs
Bachelors degree
Preferred qualifications: Self-starter with a hands on attitude; is comfortable managing ambiguity while delivering results with minimal guidance
Strong program and project management capability with exceptional attention to detail
Excellent keynote presentation, written and verbal communication skills
Exceptional relationship-building and interpersonal skills to develop strong working partnerships inside and outside of Apple
Comfort working closely with product and engineering, operations and business development teams to solve complicated challenges
Energetic and collaborative teammate who never loses focus on the customer experience
High standards and strive for the best customer experience, but willing to be flexible and make compromises when necessary.
Passion for entertainment, media, and consumer technology

title: Applied AI Scientist - Multimodal Intelligence
description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Multifaceted, amazing people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. Join us in this truly exciting era of Artificial Intelligence to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple products & experiences! We are continuously advancing the state of the art in Computer Vision and Machine Learning, touching all aspects of language and multimodal foundation models, from data collection, data curation to modeling, evaluation and deployment. As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming research directions in the field of multimodal foundation models that will inspire future Apple products. You will be working alongside highly accomplished and deeply technical scientists and engineers to develop pioneering solutions for challenging problems. This is a unique opportunity to be part of what forms the future of Apple products that will touch the lives of many people. We (Multimodal Intelligence Team) are looking for an Applied AI Scientist to work on the field of Generative AI and multimodal foundation models. Our team has an established track record of shipping features that leverage multiple sensors, such as FaceID, RoomPlan and hand tracking in VisionPro, as well as a strong research presence in the multimodal AI community. Our publications span multimodal pre-training, vision-language models, video-language models, and multimodal alignment. We are focused on building experiences that demonstrate the power of our sensing hardware as well as large foundation models.
This position requires a highly motivated person who wants to help us bridge the gap between research advances and practical applications in generative AI and multimodal foundation models. You will be responsible for evaluating and adapting emerging research, conducting applied research experiments, and working with engineering teams to transform promising approaches into robust solutions, taking into account future hardware design and product needs. In addition, you will have an opportunity to engage and collaborate with several teams across Apple to deliver the best products.
Minimum qualifications: Experience in deep learning with demonstrated work in at least one area of multimodal systems (e.g. vision, language, video, etc.).
Proficiency in Python and in a modern deep learning framework such as PyTorch or JAX.
Experience with rapid prototyping, reproduction, and validation of research ideas.
Master's or equivalent practical experience, in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or related technical field.
Preferred qualifications: PhD, or equivalent practical experience, in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.
Demonstrated expertise in deep learning, with either: A publication record in relevant conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV,COLM, etc), or a strong track record of applying deep learning techniques to real-world products.
Experience with foundation models (language or multimodal).
Familiarity with large-scale data pipelines, including data curation, preprocessing, and efficient storage.
Experience fine-tuning or optimizing large models for production deployment.
Experience applying foundation models to build autonomous or semi-autonomous agents, including planning, task decomposition, and multi-step reasoning.
Familiarity with privacy-preserving or on-device machine learning.
Ability to work effectively in a multi-functional, collaborative environment.

title: Applied Machine Learning Research Engineer - Multimodal for Human Understanding
description:
We’re starting to see the incredible potential of multimodal foundation and large language models, and many applications in the computer vision and machine learning domain that previously appeared infeasible are now within reach. We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled Applied Machine Learning Research Engineer to join our team in the Video Computer Vision group and help us push the boundaries of human understanding. The Video Computer Vision org has pioneered human-centric real-time features such as FaceID, FaceKit, and Gaze and Hand gesture control which have changed the way millions of users interact with their devices. We balance research and product requirements to deliver Apple quality, pioneering experiences, innovating through the full stack, and partnering with HW, SW and AI teams to shape Apple's products and bring our vision to life.
In this role, you will drive ground breaking development at the intersection of AI, generative modeling, and computer vision. You will work across the full lifecycle—from foundational investigation to practical applications—designing, implementing, and evaluating novel algorithms and models.
Your primary focus will be human understanding, including human motion, activities, and representation learning. A major aspect of the role involves designing, implementing, evaluating and productizing ML systems capable of human and activity understanding.
This position offers a unique opportunity to innovate, build, and ship: you will take your conceptual ideas to products that reach millions of users worldwide. You will collaborate with a diverse group of experts—research scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, data scientists, human-interface designers, and domain specialists—working in an environment that values experimentation, ownership, and continuous learning.
By staying at the forefront of advancements in AI, machine learning, and computer vision, you will play a direct role in driving innovation, influencing the evolution of Apple products, and meaningfully enhancing user experience on a global scale.
Minimum qualifications: Strong experience developing machine learning models.
Proficiency in Python and solid software engineering fundamentals.
Experience with at least one deep learning framework (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, or equivalent).
Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, plus 3 years of relevant industry experience.
Preferred qualifications: Hands-on experience training and deploying production-grade ML models.
Experience developing multimodal LLMs or generative models.
Production-level experience with a compiled language (e.g., Swift, C++).
Expertise in one or more areas: computer vision, machine learning, multimodal LLMs, Reinforcement Learning, Agentic AI.
PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on computer vision, machine learning, or multimodal systems.
Demonstrated problem-solving ability, strong sense of ownership and product shipment.

title: Art Director
description:
Marcom is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.
The Design Team is responsible for the design and art direction of core communications, including product launches and seasonal campaigns, across Retail, Channel, Packaging, Keynote, and Events. Working in a highly collaborative environment, the Design Team defines the look and feel of Apple product imagery, brand identities, and on-device screen content through experimentation, critical thinking, and extraordinary attention to detail. Candidates will be considered for opportunities across our Identity, Channel, and Screens teams, bringing this craft to life across print, digital, and motion.
As an Art Director on the Design team, you will conceptualize, design, and help own innovative graphic and motion work from initial ideation through final delivery. Working in close partnership with team leadership and design producers, you will craft cohesive design systems, brand identities, and engaging product storytelling across global communications for one of the world’s most recognizable brands.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
At least 7 years of experience in graphic design, motion design, and/or art direction, building brand identities, product storytelling, and marketing campaigns from concept through final production.
A portfolio that showcases versatility across graphic design and/or motion disciplines, including branding, typography, layout, editorial, photography, illustration, CGI, and 2D/3D animation.
Hands-on expert skills in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects) and Keynote, with the ability to develop and prototype concepts across print, digital, and motion.
Preferred qualifications: Working experience with 3D design and advanced production tools (e.g., Cinema 4D, Redshift, Maya, Houdini, Nuke, Resolve).
Experience defining scalable visual and motion systems for complex, multi-channel campaigns, along with the ability to curate well-crafted visuals and custom content.
Knowledgeable about the latest Apple OS systems, Apple Software programs, and UI elements, along with the apps and other inspiration to keep content fresh.
Excellent design and conceptual skills, with the ability to mentor junior designers, direct small projects, and evaluate and redirect creative development when necessary.
Strong eye for aesthetics with the ability to tell a compelling story through visual work and push creative innovation.
Clear, confident communicator with strong organizational habits and in-depth knowledge of the creative development process, who can pitch ideas, encourage healthy debate, and accept directional feedback.
Naturally curious about design, culture, trends, and emerging technologies (including generative AI, AR/VR, and spatial computing).

title: Associate Event Manager, Creator Experiences
description:
Worldwide Events and Experiences brings the best of Apple to life, showcasing our products, services and the values that drive our company. From global product launches and tailored creator experiences to impactful partner engagements and inspiring internal events, this team is charged with managing the end-to-end planning, production, in person experiences and all the unique details that make these events special. The team includes professionals with backgrounds in event design, management, operations, broadcast, and production. We’re looking for inventive and collaborative people from a variety of creative fields. If that’s you, then your next home may be here!
The Associate Event Manager, Creator Experiences will play a key role in bringing events to life - spanning launch programs, bespoke creator activations, and more - from initial vision through flawless execution. This role partners closely with teams across Apple, translating objectives and product priorities into clear event plans and ensuring multiple workstreams move forward seamlessly and to the highest standard. For creator experiences, you will help shape the formats through which we engage creators around Apple products and key cultural moments. The Associate Event Manager considers the creator experience holistically, ensuring programming provides the right balance of product education, creative freedom, content opportunity and hospitality, while contributing creatively to event concepts, environments and programming - always grounding ideas in audience needs, product priorities, feasibility and budget. It's a high-impact opportunity for someone who can help shape strategic direction and vision while executing seamlessly on the ground.
In this role you will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to shape event vision and strategy, ensuring alignment from concept through go-live.
Minimum qualifications: 4+ years of relevant experience in event production, experiential marketing, creator programming, brand experiences, or related fields.
Experience with creator, influencer, media, entertainment, or culturally focused programming preferred.
Proficient in Mac and Mac tools (Keynote, Numbers, Pages).
Preferred qualifications: Steeped in social and on the pulse of culture. You know what’s happening across music, art, entertainment and tech.
You are detail obsessed and know the elements that make for a memorable and capturable experience.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently across internal and external teams.
Strong project development and management experience, including building project plans, production schedules, budgets, presentations and operational plans.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead agencies and vendors, establish expectations and drive work against agreed timelines and deliverables.
Strong creative sensibility with an ability to contribute meaningfully to experience concepts while balancing creative ambition with operational realities.
A deep appreciation for audience experience and an ability to consider the full journey from initial engagement through event completion.
BA degree or equivalent preferred.

description:
Do you have a passion for invention and self-challenge? Do you thrive on pushing the limits of what’s considered feasible? As part of our Battery Engineering group, you’ll help craft creative battery algorithm and modeling solutions that deliver more energy in smaller spaces than ever before! Join us, and you’ll help us innovate new battery technologies that continually outperform the previous iterations. By collaborating with other product development groups across Apple, you’ll push the industry boundaries of what batteries can do and improve the product experience for our customers across the world.
This position will develop battery physics-based models and machine learning algorithms to optimize battery performance.

Experience in electrochemical processes and performance / safety characterization.
Experience in physics-aware machine learning modeling and algorithms.

Experience in mathematical modeling of linear and nonlinear dynamical systems and distributed parameter systems.
Experience deploying physics-based hybrid machine learning models into mass production products.
Understanding of current state of the art production processes applicable to lithium rechargeable cells.

title: Battery System Quality Engineer
description:
Batteries power many of the most exciting devices Apple makes. Have you ever wondered how it all works? We are a key team passionate about testing core technologies such as battery design, gas gauging, and charging! We use a gas gauge (aka battery gauge) to measure battery and environmental conditions and make predictions about present and future capacity. We test the integration of hardware, software, firmware, and algorithms and help drive the quality of future Apple products. You will be testing, automating, and analyzing detailed results along with working closely with cross- functional teams to ensure product quality. You will have the opportunity to grow and develop problem solving and presentation skills. Come join our team!
We are looking for someone to develop, design and run tests for battery powered products. You’ll be responsible for validating the battery technologies on Apple products from a user experience perspective throughout their development lifecycle, from early prototypes to post-release phases.You’ll develop automation and analysis tools as required as well as analyze data and present to cross-functional partner teams.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science field and 3+ years of experience
3+ years of experience programming in Python and/or C/C++
Experience in automation and testing consumer products
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Preferred qualifications: An ambition to learn battery technologies
Strong working knowledge of UNIX-like operating systems
Ability to write high quality test plans
Ability to think creatively, problem solve, and innovate
Solid debugging experience and ability to investigate and triage complex problems
Detail oriented and strive for product excellence
Customer Focused: Passionate about the customer experience and what we can do to improve it

title: Build Automation & iOS Engineer - Services Special Project
description:
At Apple, we build products and services that enrich the everyday lives of millions of people around the world. Our Services team is at the forefront of delivering intelligent, delightful experiences powered by Generative AI — from on-device capabilities to cloud-backed features that work seamlessly across the Apple ecosystem. We are looking for a talented engineer with an automation-first mindset, who is passionate about bringing AI-driven experiences to our customers and building the CI/CD, build, and agentic tooling that helps our team ship them with confidence.
As a member of the Services engineering team, you will collaborate with a talented group of engineers, designers, and product managers to build and ship Generative AI-powered features within Apple's services ecosystem. You will also own the pipelines, automation, and triage workflows that take that work from commit to customer, and use AI to make them smarter. This role demands a creative, driven engineer who thrives in fast-paced environments and is excited about pushing the boundaries of what's possible on Apple platforms.

3+ years of software engineering experience across iOS development (Swift, UIKit/SwiftUI) and build, release, or developer tooling
Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., Jenkins) and source control (e.g., Git), including branching strategies

Experience with iOS development including Swift or Objective C
Strong cross-functional communication skills, and a passion for accessible, performant, and privacy-respecting experiences

title: Business Planning Functional Analyst, IT Governance & Planning, IS&T
description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
Business Operations, Employee Engagement, and Strategy is part of IS&T and shapes the strategy, operations, and culture of IS&T. The team oversees business planning, IS&T's partnership strategy across Apple, and the technology tools that support the organization's day-to-day operations. This team also leads IS&T's enterprise generative AI strategy and manages compliance across systems. Through its communications and employee programs, it champions the growth, inclusion, and development of everyone in IS&T and drives the standard for IS&T brand and product communications across Apple.
Our team in Information Systems & Technology (IS&T) builds and runs the planning capabilities behind how Apple invests in technology, including portfolio management, financial planning, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), workforce capacity, and procurement. Leaders rely on our products and data to follow ideas from proposal to funded project, understand what technology costs, and align people and dollars with priorities. As a Business Planning Functional Analyst, you'll turn complex business problems into products, processes, and data models that scale. You'll work in sprint-based product cycles with teammates across the U.S. and India.
We're looking for a business-minded problem solver with strong analytical skills, financial acumen, and product instincts. This is not a reporting or project administration role. You'll own outcomes for product areas within our business planning suite, from understanding the underlying problem to shipping a solution people adopt. You work directly with data instead of waiting on others, you understand how finance, procurement, workforce, and technology connect, and you think through downstream impact before making a change. You don't need deep experience in every discipline we cover, but you bring a strong foundation in a few and learn the rest quickly.
Minimum qualifications: 10+ years of experience in business analysis, financial analysis, product management, consulting, or a related field
Experience building analytical models or reports from large, complex, or incomplete datasets
Experience preparing or analyzing budgets, forecasts, actuals, and variance reports, including OPEX and CAPEX
Experience analyzing large datasets in Excel or BI tools to find trends, variances, and data quality issues
Experience translating business needs into written product or system requirements, such as user stories or functional specifications
Experience working across Finance, Engineering, Procurement, or IT Operations in a large organization
Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, information systems, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Preferred qualifications: Experience contributing to work in two or more of the following: portfolio management, TCO and cost allocation, workforce planning, procurement, or hierarchy management
Background in FP&A, IT financial management, management consulting, business intelligence, or enterprise product management
Experience building dashboards in BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Superset
Experience using enterprise portfolio management, ERP, or IT service management platforms such as Broadcom Clarity
Experience documenting data models, data quality rules, or system integrations
Curiosity and intellectual humility, with a habit of asking questions to understand the real problem
Comfort working through ambiguity in a fast-moving environment, while demonstrating Apple's values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities

title: CAD Automation and ML Engineer
description:
Are you passionate about designing the world's most advanced silicon? Do you want to write software that helps create the next generation of processors and enable the next remarkable Apple innovation? If so, we invite you to consider joining our team at Apple.
We seek an engineer with a passion for hardware and strong programming and collaboration skills. You will gain hands-on experience in applying machine learning to circuit design automation and the reuse of custom intellectual property (IP). You will develop innovative pipelines to enable design engineers to efficiently drive and interact with their transistor-level analysis workflows, delivering diverse IPs to our numerous cutting-edge integrated circuits (ICs) in development.
In this role, you will acquire a broad spectrum of knowledge spanning various disciplines and stages of silicon IP development, including applications in machine learning (ML) and large language model (LLM) technologies. These LLM applications encompass tasks such as information retrieval, triage, and chatbot development, alongside traditional silicon design areas such as transistor-level extraction, timing analysis, static/dynamic IR analysis, simulations, power EM analysis, signal EM analysis, logic equivalency checks (LEC), and signoff.
The successful candidate will thrive in dynamic, collaborative environments and demonstrate a hands-on, enthusiastic, and self-motivated approach. They will possess a strong drive to succeed in challenging settings and be eager to tackle challenges with innovative solutions. If you are passionate about delivering exceptional user experiences and paying meticulous attention to detail, this role may be the perfect fit for you. As a member of our team, your contributions will directly impact the experiences of millions of Apple customers by delivering state-of-the-art processors to the diverse range of Apple products.
In this highly visible role, your primary responsibilities will include:
• Developing innovative ML and large language model applications to understand, explain, and interact with advanced circuit design software systems. Designing and implementing their interaction with our extensive compute infrastructure.
• Identifying opportunities for optimizing, expediting, and reusing the delivery of hardware IP assets.
• Actively involving yourself in supporting various ML and large language model development processes, including understanding input data, troubleshooting output, resolving software challenges that may impact project timelines, and delivering solutions to our internal customers.
• Closely collaborating with diverse design teams, including Custom Digital, Analog, Mixed-Signal, and more, to understand their needs and requirements for various ML and large language model applications. Applying advanced techniques to address these requirements across multiple products and reduce duplicate design work.
• Working in tandem with other experts in CAD to validate their ML-based applications, implement enhancements, and evaluate external vendor packages and solutions from EDA (Electronic Design Automation) providers and open-source.
Minimum qualifications: BS in Computer Science or related field
Preferred qualifications: Experience in developing object-oriented programs, utilizing data structures, and writing algorithms. Python is preferred.
Knowledge of basic machine learning techniques
Day-to-day experience working with the UNIX shell environment and code revision control systems
Knowledge of basic electrical engineering topics
Experience leading academic software development projects
Relevant internship, research position, or industry experience
Proficiency in machine learning algorithms, large language models, fine-tuning, retrieval augmented generation, and prompt engineering
Knowledge of transistor-level electrical engineering and related software tools for circuit analysis, such as simulation, timing, EM/IR, layout, extraction, or power analysis
Experience in electrical engineering machine learning applications
Exposure to server management, or parallel computing platforms such as LSF, NC, AWS, etc.
Experience creating web technologies using React, REST APIs, or equivalent
Strong communication and presentation skills
Commitment to excellence and productivity
Experience in developing large scale software systems in multi-user, multi-site environments as part of a team of developers.

description:

We are seeking a Head of Emerging Technology Strategy & Partnerships to decide where Apple places its next bets in the enterprise and AI ecosystem — and to build the team that turns those bets into adopted, repeatable business. This is a working manager role: you will personally originate and run a portfolio of strategic partnerships and market activation plans for Apple's highest-priority emerging technology initiatives, while building and coaching a team that runs the same playbook with increasing independence. No other platform company can pair this kind of ecosystem reach with Apple's architecture for privacy, security, and on-device intelligence — your job is to turn that architectural advantage into a commercial one, continuously, as hybrid AI redraws what partners and customers expect.
Because these partnerships are won on technology, you're a fit if you can go deep with engineers and architects on how it works and why it differentiates, and carry that substance into a funded, resourced, measurable commercial motion with C-suite leaders. You also bring the people instincts to grow a team of originators rather than just carry the portfolio yourself. We're looking for someone with big ideas who also knows how to get things built, funded, and shipped — a rare combination, and the core of this role.
As the Head of Emerging Technology Strategy & Partnerships, you will personally own a set of strategic initiatives and partnership pursuits end-to-end, while leading a team that owns equivalent portfolios across other emerging technology initiatives — from market activation and ecosystem engagement to technical solutioning and go-to-market design. As a working manager, you'll balance hands-on deal leadership with accountability for the people doing the same work: setting direction, developing capability, and ensuring the team operates as a high-performing, well-coached unit.
In this role, you will:
- Shape the How of Strategic Initiatives: Translate Apple's emerging technology bets into concrete market activation plans: the ecosystem required to pull the Apple platform through, the early adopters positioned to become lighthouse customers, and the enabling technologies and integrations needed to get there. You decide the motions, not just the destination — and you're accountable for measurable outcomes, not activity.
- Own a Working Portfolio: Personally originate, qualify, negotiate, and activate a dedicated set of strategic partnerships across enterprise platforms, AI frontier labs, and industry-specific ISVs — engaging daily with senior leaders and technical decision-makers across that ecosystem. - Solution Technology Win-Wins with Partners: Technology is what wins these partnerships, not relationships alone. Carry what you learn into Apple's product and platform roadmap discussions with clear technical rationale and business impact, and hold your team to the same standard — every partnership rests on a technology thesis, not just a commercial one.
- Build Apple's Differentiated Advantage: Architect joint value propositions and go-to-market strategies that establish clear, differentiated advantage through Apple's platform — on-device AI, security, and privacy architecture — and the ecosystem around it. Articulate precisely where Apple's silicon, OS, and services differentiate from alternatives, and translate that into what a partner gains by building on Apple. As hybrid AI becomes the defining lever in enterprise technology, continuously evolve Apple's partner value proposition, and your team's skill set, to keep that advantage expanding.
- Architect Repeatable Motions: Turn one-off wins into frameworks: partner qualification criteria (including technical fit and integration readiness), joint business planning models, reference architectures, and go-to-market plays (co-sell, co-marketing, enablement, pipeline development) that scale beyond any single relationship and beyond any single deal you personally run.

Coach and develop direct reports through regular 1:1s, feedback, and career planning — including building their technical depth in Apple's platform and in partner technologies. Manage performance — calibrating against expectations and addressing gaps directly and with empathy. Make hiring decisions and build a diverse, high-caliber team. - Measure and Evolve: Track partner-sourced pipeline, revenue, and activation metrics. Monitor competitive and industry trends to keep strategy current. Use both to decide what to double down on, what to pause, and where the next emerging technology bet should go.
Minimum qualifications: 12+ years in business development, strategic partnerships, or ecosystem development within enterprise technology, with a track record of originating and activating partnerships that drove measurable go-to-market outcomes — not just relationship management.
8+ years of people management experience, including setting goals, coaching, managing performance, and making hiring decisions for a team.
Experience across at least three of: global systems integrators, enterprise software (ISVs), AI/ML companies, consulting firms, healthcare/fintech solution providers, or VC/PE ecosystems.
Deep technical fluency in enterprise AI and platform technology, including on-device vs. cloud architecture tradeoffs for privacy, security, and compliance, and the ability to explain what differentiates one platform or product from another in terms engineers and architects respect.
Demonstrated experience co-developing solutions with partners or engineering teams — shaping integration architectures, defining product or software enhancements, and influencing roadmaps — in a way that produced mutual, measurable adoption.
Ability to architect repeatable partnership frameworks that scale beyond individual relationships, and to execute joint go-to-market strategies (co-sell, co-marketing, enablement, pipeline development).
Strong commercial acumen: partnership agreements, joint business planning, revenue-sharing, and investment frameworks.
Proven ability to engage and influence C-suite/VP executives and drive partner investment decisions.

Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills; able to operate across a global, matrixed organization with significant autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

title: Machine Learning Researcher: Agentic Post-Training for On-Device Models
description:

You will own the projects end to end: identify capability gaps, formulate hypotheses, build training pipelines, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate frontier research into Apple products that deliver meaningful value to users.

This is a hands-on role. You will review designs and experiments, stay close to the data, and mentor a team of scientists and engineers while you recruit and grow it. You will partner with engineering, applied machine learning, quality assurance, and program management teams, and you will present quality status, risks, and trade-offs for your areas to senior leadership. We're looking for someone with a proven track record in:
Building automated grading systems that scale to large, frequently changing datasets and using them to drive
improvements in models and product features.
Defining metrics and evaluation sets that reflect real user behavior and predict real-world quality.
Turning evaluation findings into action by partnering with engineering and applied machine learning teams to diagnose failures and ship fixes.
Contributing evaluation results to release processes as explicit quality gates.
Growing senior individual contributors and technical leads from within a team, and recruiting strong talent in competitive hiring markets
Minimum qualifications: 6+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, or machine learning evaluation, including 3+ years of
direct people management of scientists or engineers.
Track record of hiring, developing, and leading teams of applied scientists, data scientists, or machine learning
engineers.
Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based autograders and rubrics, including rubric design, evaluation
set development, validation, and calibration.
Experience evaluating conversational AI, search, recommendation, or ranking systems, using both offline metrics
and online experimentation.
Strong command of statistics and experimental design, including A/B testing and interpreting noisy metrics.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing engineers and senior leaders
Preferred qualifications: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent
experience.
Experience evaluating agentic or tool-use systems that take real-world actions, including multi-turn behavior,
planning, and task completion.
Experience with relevance and ranking evaluation, including graded relevance judgments and ranking metrics.
Experience with groundedness and factuality evaluation of generated responses.
Experience with logging infrastructure and instrumentation for AI product quality measurement.
Experience generating and validating synthetic evaluation data.
Experience evaluating systems that integrate with third-party partner APIs.
Experience with privacy-preserving evaluation practices.

title: Senior Motion Scientist - Sensing & Connectivity
description:
The Motion & Interaction team designs and delivers intuitive customer experiences through motion sensing. When you simply raise your wrist, shake your head, or move your device to interact, it’s the work of engineers and scientists on this team. Our fingerprints can be found across core capabilities and experiences on iPhone, Watch, AirPods, Vision Pro, and other Apple products. We are a multidisciplinary team, uniting expertise in algorithms, software, hardware, and design. We come from diverse backgrounds in software engineering, firmware development, machine learning, signal processing, controls, statistics, and more. Our environment values engineers who proactively seek responsibility for complex systems with deep technical challenges.
We are seeking a self-motivated senior scientist to build Apple's next-generation sensor fusion and state estimation technologies. You will design, implement, and validate estimation and control algorithms for low-power embedded systems, optimizing for power, memory, and real-time performance. You will take ideas from early prototype to production, often where the solution doesn't exist yet. You will work closely with engineers, project managers, and designers, and your features will reach millions of users every day.
Minimum qualifications: MS or PhD in controls, robotics, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or 7+ years of equivalent experience
Deep knowledge of classical and modern control theory and estimation, including nonlinear estimation, observability, and filter consistency
Track record of shipping impactful features on schedule
Preferred qualifications: Embedded or real-time C/C++ production code
Signal processing, motion estimation, and system modeling
IMU-based inertial navigation, attitude estimation or sensor calibration
Machine learning combined with robust classical, model-based methods
Multi-modal algorithms using IMU, images, video, and/or audio
Excellent communication and collaboration skills

description:
