title: Senior Security Engineer - Security Assurance Scaling
description:
Apple Services Engineering (ASE), the team behind iCloud and Media services and the infrastructure that powers them, is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to partner with engineering teams working on new products and features. You will collaborate with developers, site reliability engineers, and security teams to protect ASE services and design a secure foundation for services at Apple. Your work will include scaling assurance activities, including security risk assessments, threat modeling, and development of security standards. You will work with partner teams in security engineering, privacy, and offensive security to keep Apple's services secure for our users. If you love diving into complex technical systems, sharing security improvements, and making security better, we want to talk with you!
In this role, you will partner with infrastructure and application teams to identify areas where security standards and where security controls should be applied across the ASE organization. You will work with engineering teams throughout their development lifecycle, conduct security reviews, and develop threat models, using the insights from these engagements to build standard methodologies. As Apple's security risk experts for these services, you will help prioritize which security capabilities and controls need to be applied, and partner with our security engineering team and other platform teams to get them enforced. You will help define, prioritize, and advocate for platform-wide security improvements, raising the security bar for all engineering teams at Apple.
As a technical lead responsible for the security of Apple's internet-facing services and backend infrastructure, you will be:
Innately curious, listening for nuances and digging into details to understand systems and their weaknesses
Able to identify areas ripe for improvement and establish appropriate security goals
Experienced and comfortable establishing relationships with teams to drive security improvements
Current on new security technologies, vulnerabilities, and methodologies
Able to identify opportunities for automated enforcement and partner with security and platform engineering teams to implement them
Able to use data to drive security review efficiency and prioritize high-value security team engagement
Responsible for security decisions impacting millions of users
Minimum qualifications: 8 or more years conducting security reviews, threat modeling, tracking findings, and communicating risk to engineering and leadership
Hands-on experience in cloud security engineering with demonstrated expertise in securing at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or AliCloud) in production environments
Experience securing cloud-native applications and workloads, including containerized environments (Kubernetes/EKS/GKE), serverless architectures (Lambda/Cloud Functions), and modern CI/CD pipelines
Experience building, evaluating or directing the use of AI/ML-based security tooling to scale secure design review capacity, demonstrating the ability to recognize and act on automation opportunities
Conversant in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, Go, or Swift
Preferred qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
Experience identifying and prioritizing security enforcement points within infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi) and CI/CD pipelines, and partnering with platform/security engineering teams to embed controls that apply consistently across many teams, rather than relying on manual, one-off reviews
Familiarity with policy-as-code approaches (e.g., Open Policy Agent, Sentinel, Checkov) sufficient to define control requirements and evaluate proposed implementations for coverage and risk reduction, even if not personally authoring the policy code

title: Senior Software Engineer (Platform Engineer), G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE)
description:
G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE) is IS&T's dedicated technology partner for Apple's general and administrative functions — including people, finance, facilities, legal, and security. The team builds and delivers integrated technology solutions that keep these functions running efficiently and securely at global scale. GSE also works closely with business teams to develop custom tools that improve productivity and bring greater automation and consistency to G&A operations across Apple.
When you engineer for People Systems, your users are Apple’s most vital asset: its People. We are seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to shape the technical strategy for People Systems with a passion for platforms where configuration is the product, and agentic workflows that redefine what's possible.
You will be working on a Platform that helps define features. Data models, rules, workflows, permissions, screens and reports are all versioned configuration, interpreted at runtime, so the people closest to a problem can change how the system behaves without waiting for a release. Hundreds of components must behave as one system. We are looking for a passionate engineer who can make that true.
We value engineers who bring both technical excellence and product thinking. You'll make the architectural calls that balance fast delivery against long-term platform health, and build systems that are scalable, secure and resilient by design rather than by retrofit.
This role requires someone who thrives on complexity but ships simplicity.
Collaboration is central to how we work. You’ll partner with product managers and cross-functional engineering teams to understand problems deeply before reaching for solutions. The best engineers here are the ones who ask “why” before “how.” If you care deeply about precision, data integrity, and crafting platforms where scale meets human empathy, come join us to do the best work of your life.
Minimum qualifications: 8 years proven experience developing software in a professional capacity. Longer experience strongly preferred.
6 years proven experience with Java or Kotlin, including mastery in concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization techniques.
8 years proven mastery in OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code.
6 years proven experience in least one modern frontend stack (such as React/Next.js) coupled with LLM feature development, utilizing the top 3 ecosystem languages: TypeScript, Python, and JavaScript.
B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional work experience.
Preferred qualifications: Track record of leading software projects that span multiple, distributed teams as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring senior-level software engineers.
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Apple Ads
description:
Apple is where we use the power of technology to enrich people's lives. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.
Join the Apple Ads Engineering team and help build an advertising platform that benefits both customers and advertisers. Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV — helping people discover content, supporting creators and publishers, and connecting advertisers of all sizes with engaged audiences, all with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. In this role, you will design, develop, and launch the highly-performant, internet-scale backend systems that select and deliver the right ads in real time, collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure to bring elegant solutions into production at Apple scale.
You will design, develop, and operate the distributed services that make real-time ad selection possible at Apple. You will architect and build low-latency, high-availability, high-throughput ad-serving systems in a cloud environment, engineer secure and scalable data processing pipelines that operate on petabyte-scale datasets, and implement performant services that handle very high data volumes and QPS. You will work cross-functionally to ensure that optimal and correct ads are available for real-time selection, and that observability and flexibility are provided for stakeholders. While this role focuses on the candidate retrieval part of Apple Ads, we are not constrained by organization structure and offer the flexibility to contribute across a variety of backend systems, including opportunities to apply algorithmic search, machine learning, NLP, and AI to hard retrieval problems. You will write clean, efficient, well-documented code, participate in code reviews, and mentor other engineers on the team. Collaboration with internal partners across indexing, search, serving, operations, and program management to define requirements and deliver high-quality solutions is essential. You should be passionate about building products that protect user privacy and thrive in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities — and have fun doing it.
Minimum qualifications: 6+ years of industry experience architecting and developing internet-scale server software for Linux systems, including scalable micro-services or data-driven platforms.
Strong background in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
Strong coding skills in Go, Java, Rust, C++, Scala, or a similar OOP/Functional language.
Hands-on experience designing and operating scalable micro-services.
Experience with search technologies such as Lucene, Solr, or Elasticsearch. Expertise with NoSQL datastores (e.g., Cassandra).
Proficiency with data processing technologies (e.g., Kafka, Spark, Flink) and methods for processing petabyte-scale datasets.
Experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, EC2, and EKS/Kubernetes. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Demonstrated ability to work on complex problems and systems, alone or as part of a team, to deliver complete systems end to end.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical cross-functional teams, including operations and project management partners.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Experience creating groundbreaking technology for algorithmic search, machine learning, natural language processing, and artificial intelligence.
Experience building ad-serving, recommendation, or large-scale retrieval systems.
Familiarity with real-time bidding, candidate retrieval, or ranking pipelines.
Experience operating services with strict latency and availability SLOs.
Familiarity with privacy-preserving system design and data-handling practices.
Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals — consensus, replication, and fault tolerance.
A desire to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment, and a fast learner with strong motivation for growing and learning new technologies.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Apple Card & Savings
description:
The Apple Card & Savings team is building the financial products that put users in control of their money. We built Apple Card to reinvent how credit cards work, and we continue to launch groundbreaking features used by millions of people every day. We are looking for an experienced engineer who loves owning critical services end to end, takes pride in operational excellence, and thrives in a highly regulated environment where correctness, reliability, and compliance requirements shape every technical decision.
You'll design, build, test, deliver, and operate the distributed services that power Apple Card and Savings — from applications, accounts, and transactions to payments, savings transfers, rewards, and customer notifications. You'll be given the support of a talented team, access to modern technologies, and the autonomy to take full ownership of your work.
Our team operates as DevOps: we build what we run. As an experienced member of the team, you'll own features from specification through production, review code, contribute to technical design, write clear documentation, and help onboard and mentor teammates. Experience debugging production issues using logs, metrics, and traces, and following through on fixes and post-incident improvements.

Experience using generative AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle to produce high-quality software.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Apple Services Engineering
description:
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds the container and virtualization runtime technology that powers Apple's next-generation compute platform. We're a fast-moving, highly skilled team of systems engineers designing and developing the virtualization-based runtimes that run Virtual Machines and Linux Containers across our data center, with privacy, security, and performance as first-class requirements.
We're starting a new team focused on one question: how do we patch the node software across our datacenter fleet faster, and more often, with minimal impact to the workloads running on it? We're looking for a domain expert to decide the approach and then build and lead the team that delivers it.
Today, updating a node's software means choosing between speed and workload impact. This team's job is to remove that tradeoff, so we can patch the fleet faster and more often with minimal impact on users. We have not chosen an approach. Live migration, snapshot and restore, kexec-based host updates, live patching, and in-place upgrade of the runtime and VMM are all options, and a different approach may fit better than any of them. We are looking for an expert to decide and guide: which approach, or combination, gets us there, what it costs in workload impact and operational risk, and how we measure the result.
You will:

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Distributed Storage
description:
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides systems that power many of Apple’s customer-facing services - including iCloud, iTunes, Siri and Maps. We deliver the core infrastructure primitives that enable teams across Apple to build services our customers rely on every day.
This is a ground-up effort to build a highly reliable, self-managing and scalable storage layer that can support exabyte-scale data and diverse access patterns. This new layer will also serve as the foundation for adopting and optimizing next-generation storage devices, enabling Apple to leverage emerging drive technologies with new performance and density characteristics. If you enjoy designing distributed systems that operate as a cohesive storage fabric, we want to hear from you.
We are creating a unified storage abstraction layer that will serve as the foundational layer for Apple’s distributed object, block, and future file storage systems. This new layer will provide a consistent API, common metadata model, scalable data distribution and high-performance IO path for workloads running in Apple Cloud.
Engineers on this team will work on the core of a unified storage layer designed to manage data objects, placement, redundancy and IO operations across thousands of nodes. You will help define the fundamental building blocks that unify different storage backends—object, block and future file interfaces—behind a single, extensible abstraction.
You will design consistent metadata services, build scalable data distribution algorithms, implement robust replication and fault-recovery mechanisms, and develop client-side libraries and protocols that expose a uniform interface to workloads across Apple.
Each component is being designed to support self-healing behaviors, automatic rebalancing and high-throughput, low-latency access paths.
We are looking for engineers who enjoy building foundational storage systems, solving complex distributed coordination challenges, and shaping a platform that will underpin Apple’s cloud storage strategy for many years.
Minimum qualifications: Strong problem-solving skills rooted in data structures, distributed systems, and concurrency.
7+ years of professional experience building and operating distributed systems.
Demonstrated ownership and history of delivering production systems.
Proficiency in one or more systems languages: Java, Rust, asynchronous and thread-safe programming.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
BS in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
Preferred qualifications: Background in object, block or file system internals.
Experience with modern storage devices such as zoned block devices, sequential-write media or emerging high-density magnetic recording technologies.
MS in Computer Science

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services (Forge)
description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it!
Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it.
Forge is part of Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), within Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. Forge is building the platform Apple's engineering organizations can use to take a service from code to running in production. That path has traditionally run through a series of separate specialist systems. We are bringing it together on a common platform with a shared core, so a team goes from allocated capacity to a live production service without assembling the pieces themselves. Our job is to get teams to production quickly, on a platform that stays secure and reliable without them having to think about it.
Our charter is deliberately wide and still growing, reaching from the physical fleet in the data center to the surfaces engineering teams build against, and extending into new environments and new classes of infrastructure as Apple's needs evolve. We are a small team with outsized reach, bringing an AI-first mindset to how the platform operates and improves itself, and the best work we do takes one team's hardest problem and turns it into a capability every team inherits.
You will work with product owners, infrastructure owners, and partner engineers to turn ambiguous, high-impact problems into clean solutions. You'll own products that ETS teams depend on every day. title: Staff / Sr. ML Engineer, Web Indexing
description:

title: Deployment Engineer (Field Operations)
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Deployment Engineer, you are the technical expert and central lifeline for our field crews. You are the voice of Base from mission control, providing end-to-end guidance to ensure every battery installation and service call is safe, efficient, and successful. This is not a typical support role. You’ll be the interdisciplinary link between our field electricians, our engineers, and our members, using tools like Grafana and Retool to monitor system health while troubleshooting issues over the phone, text, and Slack. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop a 360-degree view of our technology. 



You’ll gain real-world expertise in hardware, software, and field operations, all while contributing directly to the improvement of our product and deployment playbooks. This role is best suited for a tech-savvy experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex problems in real-time or for a fast-learning generalist that can flex into any scope and excel. Over time, this position could grow into potential field leadership, operations, or engineering roles.



What You'll Do

 - Typical week: ~75% of your time live-supporting (from our HQ in Austin, TX) field crews during installations and service calls; ~25% analyzing issues, updating playbooks, and collaborating with other teams.

 - Provide end-to-end guidance and troubleshooting for battery installations and service calls over phone, text, and Slack.

 - Serve as the first line of technical support for in-field electrical questions and hardware issues, escalating complex compliance issues and documenting new solutions.

 - Identify field issue trends over time and flag high impact issues to hardware, software, or deployment teams.

 - Work closely with Member Experience to ensure the best possible experience for our members.

 - Create and maintain troubleshooting aid and hardware defect logs.

 - Create, track, and close service tickets through Jira or Odoo.

 - You’ll directly impact installation speed, safety, and uptime while your insights will shape our hardware roadmap and operating procedures.
   
   

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years in a technical support, electrical, or IT troubleshooting role.

 - Strong foundation in electrical concepts; licensed electrician or hands-on field experience is a plus but not required.

 - Proven ability to quickly learn complex technical systems (electrical code, hardware, and software tools).

 - 4-year degree or equivalent electrical experience.

 - Strong communication and organization skills – bilingual is a plus but not required.

 - Ability to multitask, remain calm under pressure, de-escalate high pressure situations, be decisive, and practice patience.

 - Desire and ability to think analytically and creatively to resolve complex issues and suggest process improvements.

 - Attention to detail in communicating accurately and clearly, tracking field interactions, and documenting solutions.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-paced environment to quickly adapt to changes while maintaining high-quality support.

 - Tech savvy, with a knack for quickly mastering new tools and systems.

 - Team player motivated by the mission who always puts the company’s best interests first.



About the Team

Deployment Engineering is Base Power’s mission control for field operations, acting as the real-time support system for our installation crews. This team sits at the intersection of field electricians, engineering, and member experience, ensuring every install and service call runs smoothly, safely, and efficiently.

Beyond live troubleshooting, the team plays a key role in identifying trends, improving deployment playbooks, and influencing product and operational decisions. Their work directly impacts installation speed, system uptime, and the overall member experience—making them a critical driver of our growth.

This is a team built for people who enjoy fast-paced problem solving, cross-functional collaboration, and developing a full-stack understanding of hardware, software, and field operations.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

title: Senior Accounting Manager
description:
ABOUT BROCCOLI AI

At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.

We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.

Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.

Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

Today:

 - Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.

 - We've grown to $25M+ ARR in under two years.

 - We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.

 - We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator.

We're still just getting started.



THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Accounting Manager, our first in-house accountant, to own Broccoli's accounting, payroll, and tax end to end. You'll run the close, own revenue accounting for a fast-growing, usage-based business, keep us compliant in every state we operate in, and build the controls and systems that get us audit ready.

This is a deeply hands-on role reporting to our Head of Finance. You'll do the work yourself, make the accounting calls and document them, and work with our external accountant and outside tax advisors. You'll partner with Sales, Customer Success, People and Engineering. There's real building to do: a faster close, cleaner revenue data, tighter controls, and an AI-native finance stack where automation carries the repetitive work.



WHERE WE ARE TODAY

We run on QuickBooks Online, with Measure on top of Stripe for billing, Rippling for payroll and HR, and Brex for cards, bill pay and reimbursements. Revenue mixes subscription fees with usage-based billing, across customers from single-location contractors to multi-site enterprise operators. We have a US company and a subsidiary in India, and an external accountant who handles day-to-day transactions today and will work with you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the close and the financial statements. Run the close calendar, journal entries, accruals and reconciliations across bank, card, Stripe and payroll. Deliver accurate monthly financials and flux analysis on a business-day-10 timeline, then make it faster.

 - Own revenue accounting and billing. Set and document our ASC 606 policies for subscription, usage-based and multi-location enterprise contracts. Own the billing system (Measure, on Stripe), its sync to the GL, usage accruals and true-ups, and invoice adjustments.

 - Own AR and AP. Run collections, reserves and write-off policy across a customer base that runs from single-location contractors to large multi-site operators. Own vendor setup, bank-detail verification, bill pay, and card and reimbursement policy in Brex against a defined approval matrix, with real segregation of duties.

 - Own payroll. Run payroll in Rippling end to end, including new hires, terminations, pay changes, benefits deductions and off-cycle payments, and reconcile every run to the GL. Own multi-state payroll tax: registrations as we hire in new states, withholding, unemployment insurance, filings, and year-end W-2s and 1099s.

 - Own tax. Stand up sales tax: run the nexus analysis, register where we need to, then set up and enable tax calculation in our billing system and own the filings. Manage income and franchise tax with our outside advisors, plus 1099s and state annual filings.

 - Run treasury operations. Execute bank and card operations, wires and cash movements within approved limits, and keep cash reconciled across our accounts.

 - Get us audit ready. Build the policies, controls and schedules (revenue, equity compensation under ASC 718, prepaids and accruals) that make a first audit and investor diligence straightforward.

 - Support planning and reporting. Deliver clean, on-time actuals for budgeting and for board and investor reporting.

 - Run the international side. Own accounting, statutory compliance and intercompany funding for our India subsidiary, working with local providers.

 - Automate the work. Help choose and implement our next-generation GL, and build the automation that lets a small team run a growing company's books, so AI does the work rather than just reporting on it.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7–10 years of accounting experience, including time in-house at a venture-backed startup.

 - CPA license.

 - Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience, ideally with technology clients.

 - You've owned a monthly close and the financial statements end to end, and you've made and documented the accounting calls behind them.

 - Strong command of US GAAP, including ASC 606.

 - You've run payroll yourself, or you're ready to own it hands-on from day one.

 - You like doing the work. You're as comfortable fixing a reconciliation yourself as designing the process that prevents the next one.

 - You use AI tools in your accounting work today and have a view on where they help.

 - Excellent written communication, with the judgment to explain an accounting call to non-finance partners and to know which calls need escalating.

 - Excited to work in person five days a week with the team in San Francisco.

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.



BONUS POINTS

 - Usage-based or hybrid SaaS revenue under ASC 606.

 - You've run payroll in Rippling, including multi-state employees and off-cycle payments.

 - QuickBooks Online, Brex, and a subscription billing platform (Measure, Maxio, Chargebee, Stripe Billing or similar), including getting its data to tie to the GL.

 - You've taken a company through its first financial statement audit or a fundraising diligence process.

 - You've set up sales tax or multi-state payroll tax compliance from scratch.

 - You've migrated a company onto an AI-native accounting platform (Rillet, Campfire or similar).

 - Multi-entity or international subsidiary accounting, ideally India.

 - Commission accounting (ASC 340-40) or sales comp administration.

 - SQL or comfort pulling your own data.

 - Experience in home services or B2B SaaS selling to SMBs.



THIS ROLE MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU IF

 - You want to build and manage a team in your first year. You may be our only in-house accountant for a while.

 - You'd rather review work than do it.

 - You're looking for a remote or hybrid role.

Job Description
Cox Automotive is seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer II to join our Detection Engineering team , supporting next-generation Cyber Defense across our diverse portfolio of automotive solutions including Dealertrack, Manheim, Autotrader, Kelley Blue Book, Central Dispatch, and vAuto.
Reporting to the Director of Cyber Detection Engineering, you’ll build, tune, and maintain enterprise- and customer-focused detection capabilities, including AI-assisted detection workflows and automation, with guidance and support from senior engineers on the team. You’ll work closely with Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management to strengthen detection coverage. The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience with SIEM log analysis gained in detection engineering or a SOC, a working knowledge of Incident Response and Threat Intelligence, and uses AI tools daily to work faster and smarter. Strong verbal and written communication skills and a drive to keep learning are essential.
What You’ll Do
Cybersecurity Detection Engineering:
Build, test, and maintain detections that protect Cox Automotive’s internal systems as well as its domestic and international businesses.
Contribute to the Detection Engineering roadmap and objectives by delivering assigned work and recommending improvements to senior engineers.
Use AI tools and large language models daily to accelerate detection development, query writing, log analysis, investigation, and documentation, and validate AI output for accuracy before use.
Build and maintain AI-assisted detection and triage workflows (such as prompts, agent steps, and automated enrichment) as part of detection solutions, following established patterns and guidance from senior engineers.
Develop and tune detection rules, automated remediation playbooks, and alerts using SIEM, EDR, and SOAR platforms, tailored to Cox Automotive’s enterprise and customer threat landscape.
Use the MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS frameworks to map detections, assess coverage, and help identify gaps.
Monitor detection performance and tune detections to reduce false positives and improve effectiveness.
Collaborate with the Threat Detection and Response team to continuously improve the identification and response to threats.
Perform attack simulation testing to validate the efficacy of detection use cases, using established tools and procedures.
Support purple teaming exercises in collaboration with the Vulnerability Management team.
Support SIEM/Data Lake log ingestion by onboarding log sources, validating parsing and data quality, and troubleshooting ingestion issues, in collaboration with Cyber Defense Engineering counterparts.
Evaluate, validate, tune, and recommend retirement of detections as needed.
Collect and report detection metrics, such as alert volume, false positive rates, and coverage, on a routine basis.
Build and maintain operational guidelines, diagrams, and documentation for security detection and response.
Participate in an off-hours support rotation for security detection and response activities.
Incident Response:
Collaborate with the Incident Response team to support rapid detection and containment of cyber threats.
Build threat detection logic during incident response, with guidance, to accelerate threat identification and containment.
Contribute to improving detection and response processes based on lessons learned from incidents.
Threat Intelligence Integration:
Apply threat intelligence from the Threat Intelligence team to build and enhance detections.
Research new and emerging threats and share findings with the team to inform detection priorities.
Stakeholder Collaboration:
Partner with other Cybersecurity, Engineering, and Product teams to support successful deployment of detection and response solutions.
Support Product teams in implementing customer-focused detection and response solutions, with guidance from senior engineers.
Communicate detection capabilities and findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and escalate issues to senior engineers or leadership as needed.
Governance and Compliance:
Follow detection and response processes that adhere to regulatory requirements and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, PCI-DSS, NIST).
Maintain documentation of detection use cases, processes, and configurations.
Who You Are
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline and 2 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and up to 2 years’ experience; or 14 years’ experience in a related field
1+ year of experience in Detection Engineering or in a Security Operations Center (SOC) role. Direct Detection Engineering experience is not required for candidates with SOC experience.
Working knowledge of detection concepts, including searching and writing logic with a SIEM query language (such as SPL, KQL, or similar).
Hands-on experience with a SIEM, including searching and analyzing log data.
Working knowledge of information security, network security, security monitoring, and Incident Response fundamentals.
Demonstrated daily use of AI tools and prompt engineering to support security or technical work.
Familiarity with industry standard security technologies and services such as threat intelligence, firewalls, IPS, endpoint security, DLP, SIEM/SOAR, and Data Lakes.
Familiarity with security concepts in at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Understanding of the attack kill chain and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
Ability to work independently on defined tasks and to seek guidance when needed.
Preferred Qualifications
Security+, GSEC, GCIA, GCIH, SC-200, AWS Security Specialty, or similar certification(s).
Experience with AI/ML frameworks or building AI-assisted workflows for security applications.
Experience with SOAR automation or scripting (such as Python).
Multi-cloud security experience (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Dev Ops / Engineering / Network / System Administration experience.
Exposure to customer-focused detection and response systems.
Familiarity with Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF).

Obtain parts from approved local and national vendors as necessary for the repairs to be performed.
Accurately complete DOT forms and all other forms of documentation in timely fashion.
Independently manage parts inventory and equipment on company-issued service truck and perform periodic reconciliation.
Works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job.
Manage concurrent assigned tasks, making effective judgments as to prioritizing work related activities and time allocations.
Work with a high degree of independence and manage own daily schedule.
Work with clients and customers to assess their needs, providing information or assistance, resolving their problems, or satisfying their expectations
Adhere to company policies, processes, and procedures.
Diagnose, adjust, and repair various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Air conditioning systems, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Power steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.
Confer with customers, Dispatch, and/or Sales team to obtain descriptions of vehicle problems and to discuss work to be performed.
Inspect, test, and listen to defective equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using test instruments such as handheld computers and pressure gauges.
Requirements
High School Diploma/GED and 3 years’ experience in a related field (Combination of light & heavy duty preferred. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as any level degree/certification beyond a HS diploma/GED in a related discipline; or 5 years’ experience in a related field.
Possess and supply a set of hand tools necessary to perform required job duties.

A current and valid DOT medical card with more than four (4) months remaining until its expiration may be submitted in leu of a DOT physical. If the DOT medical card has four (4) months or less of validity remaining, a DOT physical will be required.

Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
Job Description:
About Crowe Studio
Crowe Studio is a business unit dedicated to helping clients scale smarter, transform faster, and lead in a platform-driven economy. Built for speed and flexibility, Crowe Studio operates outside the constraints of traditional professional services delivery models, giving clients access to cross-disciplinary innovation, embedded AI capabilities, and global delivery resources—all in service of solving complex business challenges in faster, smarter ways.
Through Crowe Studio, the firm provides clients with an innovation partner focused on rapid execution, deep technology integration, and high-impact results. We’re building the next generation of business models for professional services, where human expertise and AI are embedded within clients’ operations to drive ongoing impact, not just deliver isolated projects.
As a member of Crowe Studio, you will help distinguish Crowe in the market and drive the firm’s technology and innovation strategy. The future is powered by AI—come build it with us.
About Forward Deployed Engineering
The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Practice drives AI transformation through embedded consulting and engineering, enabling clients to accelerate delivery, scale solutions, and capture value faster. Our approach helps companies prove AI in their own environments, delivering results in weeks, not months.
We embed our Forward Deployed Engineers side-by-side with client teams to spot opportunities, make AI concepts real, and deploy solutions rapidly. Unlike traditional consulting approaches that rely on documented requirements and lengthy development cycles, FDEs blend engineering, product thinking, workflow design, and business understanding to achieve shared, outcome-driven ownership until measurable results are achieved.
Our engagements range from 2-hour AI Immersion Labs that turn AI noise into real use cases, to multi-week Proof of Value Sprints that prototype and deploy game-changing AI solutions. We help companies de-risk AI adoption while demonstrating solid ROI.
About the Team
We invest in expertise . You’ll have the time, space, and support to go deep on client engagements and build lasting technical and strategic mastery. You’ll work with cross-functional teams and client teams as a trusted advisor and domain expert.
We believe in continuous growth . Our team is committed to professional development and knowledge-sharing.
We protect balance . Our distributed team culture is grounded in trust and flexibility. We offer unlimited PTO, a flexible remote work policy, and a supportive environment that prioritizes sustainable, long-term performance.
About the Role
As a Forward Deployed AI Architect (Manager), you will serve as a hands-on technical authority responsible for designing, developing, and delivering innovative, production-ready AI solutions for our clients. You will own solution architecture, technical feasibility, engineering quality, and production readiness while remaining actively involved in coding, prototyping, and complex technical problem-solving.
Working within Crowe Studio's Forward Deployed Engineering practice, you will collaborate directly with clients and cross-functional teams to translate complex business challenges into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI applications. Your work will span agentic AI systems, generative AI applications, enterprise integrations, cloud-native architectures, and production deployments.
This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who wants to expand their technical leadership and architectural influence without moving away from hands-on engineering. You will guide technical decisions, establish engineering standards, mentor engineers, and communicate architectural tradeoffs with confidence. You will also be empowered to challenge technical approaches that introduce unacceptable risk or will not meet production requirements.
What You’ll Do
Architect and develop end-to-end applied AI solutions, including generative AI applications, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI-enabled enterprise workflows.
Lead solution architecture for AI build and proof-of-concept engagements, ensuring solutions are technically feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with client business objectives.
Remain hands-on across solution development, including application coding, data integration, prototyping, debugging, and technical implementation.
Design and implement cloud-native AI solutions using Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and relevant AI platforms and services.
Define architecture and integration patterns for large language models (LLMs), vector databases, APIs, microservices, enterprise data platforms, and client systems.
Take ownership of technical feasibility, solution design decisions, and build quality from initial discovery through production deployment.
Guide solutions through Architecture Review Board processes, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, responsible AI principles, and production readiness expectations.
Assess technical feasibility during client discovery sessions, solution scoping, and sales support discussions, clearly communicating technical tradeoffs, risks, and recommended approaches.
Establish engineering standards, reusable architectural patterns, technical documentation, and development best practices across client engagements.
Design solutions with appropriate evaluation frameworks, monitoring, observability, guardrails, and performance optimization to support reliable AI operations.
Collaborate with AI engineering, data engineering, MLOps, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and security teams to deliver integrated enterprise solutions.
Evaluate technical tradeoffs among custom development, managed AI services, and low-code or automation platforms to select appropriate implementation strategies.
Identify and address technical risks, including performance, scalability, security, reliability, and cost considerations.
Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and hands-on problem-solving to strengthen engineering quality and team capabilities.
Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, cloud capabilities, and engineering tools to identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 6 years of experience in production software engineering, cloud engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Strong hands-on software engineering experience, including proficiency in modern programming languages, application development, and the design and deployment of production-grade solutions.
Demonstrated experience architecting cloud-native applications and distributed systems using Azure, AWS, or GCP, including APIs, microservices, enterprise integrations, and data workflows.
Working knowledge of generative AI and LLM application patterns, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and agentic workflows.
Ability to assess technical feasibility, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and make sound engineering decisions considering scalability, security, performance, reliability, and cost.
Understanding of software and AI application lifecycle management, including testing, evaluation, production deployment, monitoring, and operational support.
Strong communication and client-facing skills, with demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions, explain complex architectural decisions, and mentor engineering teams.
Demonstrated ownership of technical delivery, engineering quality, and risk management in collaborative, fast-paced environments, with a commitment to remaining actively engaged in hands-on engineering.
Ability to travel up to 80%, depending on client and engagement requirements.
Preferred Skills
Master's degree in a technical field or relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
Experience developing and deploying production AI applications using LLMs or agent frameworks from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or similar providers, including tool orchestration and multi-step agentic workflows.
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic systems, including quality, reliability, safety, performance, and responsible AI considerations.
Advanced cloud and AI infrastructure experience, including Kubernetes, Terraform, observability, and managed AI services such as Azure AI, Amazon SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI.
Experience architecting RAG solutions, integrating vector databases (such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS), and optimizing model inference or AI application performance.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development and low-code automation platforms, such as Microsoft Power Platform, Cursor, Replit, Retool, or n8n, along with experience supporting client discovery, technical scoping, or proof-of-value engagements.

description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last-mile logistics in the long term. If you have a passion for applying robotics solutions in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!
About the Role
The Simulation team builds software, models, and environments to test on-road autonomous robot behavior and evaluate autonomy changes before deployment. We are hiring an Autonomy Simulation Engineer to improve simulation fidelity and accelerate the development and validation of autonomous delivery robots.
You will develop production simulation software and models of robot behavior and interactions with the environment, using real-world data and repeatable experiments to calibrate and validate them. Working closely with autonomy and robotics engineers, you will own projects from design through validation and report to the Simulation Lead. We expect this role to be hybrid, with some time in-office and some time remote.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Develop and maintain the simulation engine and supporting software.
Build and improve simulation models of robot behavior, other participants, and their interactions.
Calibrate and validate simulation models against real-world behavior using controlled, repeatable experiments.
Develop parameterized environments and synthetic scenarios to test conditions and interactions that are difficult to capture in the field.
Investigate differences between simulated and real-world behavior, identify contributing model assumptions and parameters, and implement improvements.
Improve simulator reproducibility, reliability, usability, and debuggability.
We’re excited about you because…
You have strong production C++ and Python experience.
You can translate real-world behavior and physical systems into practical software models.
You have experience building closed-loop or interactive simulation software, with depth in areas such as robot dynamics, physics, road-user behavior, synthetic scenario generation, or probabilistic modeling.
You have used real-world data and controlled, repeatable experiments to test, calibrate, or validate software models.
You have experience debugging complex systems and delivering reliable production software using Linux, Git, automated testing, and CI.
Experience applying machine learning to simulation modeling and validating learned models against real-world data is a plus.

DoorDash Parcel is building a new package delivery business on top of the largest local delivery network in the US, including millions of Dashers (our independent delivery partners), thousands of merchants, and DashMart (our own local fulfillment sites). Rather than copying traditional carriers, we are designing a software-driven network that delivers same-day and next-day at a cost per package customers will love. We are a small, highly autonomous team that builds with AI by default and works directly with the leaders running the business.
About the Role
We’re hiring a Director of Network Strategy & Planning to own the design of the Parcel network: where packages enter, how they move and sort, how they reach the door, and the planning systems that decide all of it. Your decisions in the first 12 months will set the cost and service curve for Parcel for years, building on an existing local logistics network and what the team has built over the last 2-3 years.

We’re excited about you because…
You have 12+ years of substantial experience leading strategy and operations in a complex, high-growth business, with a track record of building new offerings and scaling them into sustainable businesses.
You have deep experience designing or running parcel, last-mile, or logistics networks, including site design, package flow, and routing.
You have owned cost and service results for a network and make decisions based on data, including when the data disagrees with the plan.
You work well with Engineering, Data Science, and Operations to turn prototypes into products.
You move quickly and care about the details, such as testing in one city, reading the results, and then scaling or stopping.

As DoorDash grows both in scale and scope of offering, the strength of our sales engine and organizational structure must grow with it.
About the role
We are looking for a Manager in Sales Strategy and Operations to be the strategic and operational partner to our SMB Business Development (BD) team as it expands its remit and increases restaurant coverage. You will own the operating foundation for BD’s merchant sales motion, including goal setting, pipeline management, lead allocation, and performance reporting.
In this role, you will make sure we are  Making efficient, data-driven decisions,
Building scalable operating systems for a growing sales motion,
Using and advocating for AI tooling, and
Centralizing the metrics that drive sales performance. You’ll work with our Sales, Selection, Operations, Product, Finance, and Analytics teams to build and scale that foundation, helping BD win new restaurant partners and grow those partnerships.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Build from first principles. BD's sales motion is evolving to capture top restaurants in priority markets, and this role will design how it runs: goal structures, input and activity metrics, pipeline stages, and rules of engagement with adjacent sales teams. You'll question "this is how it's always been done" and build what the team needs next.
Drive operational excellence. You'll set up and run reporting cadences, rigorous pipeline reviews, and productivity inspection with sales leaders, taking each one end to end from idea to execution and grounding decisions in data.
Own lead strategy and GTM targeting. You’ll partner with our GM teams to point BD reps at the highest-value opportunities, with clear ownership across teams.
Operate at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. One day you'll size goals and model capacity for a growing team. The next you'll be in diagnosing and improving data fidelity or tracing a pacing gap to its root cause.

You have a Bachelor's degree or higher

We are leaders – Leadership is not limited to our management team. It's something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.

We are learners – Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or one minute. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our customers, merchants, and dashers.
We are one team – The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

title: Principal Visual Designer, Merchant
location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA
description:
About the Team
At DoorDash, design means making experiences for the people who order, the people who prepare, and the people who deliver. As a Designer at DoorDash, you want to build things that matter to real people. You're at your best when you can move from idea to shipped product quickly, bringing experiences to life that reach and influence users at massive scale. You'll care about whether the product you make solved a real problem for real people, or changed how someone experiences their day.
You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Product Management, dig into the data, and use LLM-powered tools alongside traditional design tools. If the LLM powered tools don’t exist yet, you build them.
About the Role
Restaurants are the heart of every neighborhood, yet most run on a patchwork of disconnected tools. We’re building DashOS, the operating system for the restaurant of the future. It’s one platform that connects delivery, in-store dining, reservations, and loyalty, across software, kiosk and POS hardware, and agentic experiences that take work off operators’ plates.
As Principal Visual Designer, you’ll set the look, feel, and identity of DoorDash’s merchant products. You’ll own the visual direction for DashOS and give merchants a recognizable identity across every surface, including hardware, where no design conventions exist yet. These products already work. Your job is to make merchants love using them.
Visual craft is the center of this role, and you’ll ship it yourself. You’ll prototype and use AI tools like Cursor and Claude to generate and refine UI, so your ideas reach production with full fidelity. You’ll also define the visual foundation of the design system (tokens, components, guidance, and examples) so designers, engineers, and AI tools all produce on-brand, high-quality UI. Engineering partners build and maintain the tooling, and you set the rules and the quality bar.
You’ll report to the Senior Director, Product Design for Merchant. This role is hybrid, with 1–2 days a week in a Design Hub.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Set the visual direction for merchant products across DashOS and bring multiple teams around a shared vision, so the work compounds instead of duplicating.
Ship high-craft interfaces with a clear point of view , turning complex, data-dense workflows into screens merchants can read at a glance in a busy kitchen or at the counter.
Own the visual foundation of the design system : define the tokens, components, usage rules and examples that both people and AI tools apply. Review generated UI against that bar, record what good looks like, and improve the system based on how teams actually use it.
Design for new surfaces. Create visual systems for points-of-sale, handhelds and agentic experiences where no existing paradigm applies.
Influence through the work. Earn trust with prototypes and shipped products instead of decks, and keep your prototypes production-ready.
Raise the bar across the team. Mentor senior designers, help close strong hires, and help people sharpen their sense of what to build and why.
We’re excited about you because…
You’ve designed interfaces that defined or reshaped a product’s look and feel, and your portfolio shows top-of-bar visual craft with range across brands and styles.
You can build what you design. You work in React, TypeScript or similar, and use AI tools to explore directions and refine UI faster than you could by hand.
You’ve set direction across a product area, and people adopted your work because it was good, not because you told them to.
You’d rather build a visual system that makes 20 designers faster and more consistent than ship one great screen yourself.
You’ve worked on complex, information-dense products such as point-of-sale, fintech, marketplaces or platform teams, and you’ve shipped with product and engineering partners, including pushing back constructively.

description:

DoorDash Labs is looking for a Senior Operations Associate to help scale drone delivery across multiple partners and cities in Texas and Tulsa, Oklahoma. You’ll own regional operational workstreams, working closely with drone partners, local teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to improve delivery reliability, support market expansion, and create a consistent experience as our network grows.

You’ll manage a large team across multiple sites and cities, setting clear priorities, coaching team members, and holding the team accountable for consistent execution. DoorDash’s ML Serving Platform delivers tens of millions of predictions per second across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, powering search, recommendations, advertising, and logistics. We build request routing, online feature retrieval, and CPU/GPU inference capabilities that help ML and product teams deploy and operate models independently.
About the Role
We’re looking for a hands-on senior engineer to lead core serving investments. We’re especially interested in engineers who have scaled ranking and recommendation systems in production. You’ll make architectural decisions, write production code, and guide delivery with ML, product, and compute infrastructure partners.
Your first 6–12 months will focus on enabling new ranking and recommendation models, including generative approaches, in online production. You’ll resolve bottlenecks with early product partners and turn those solutions into reusable platform capabilities. Success means faster adoption while meeting model quality, latency, reliability, and cost targets.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Lead projects from customer problem through design, implementation, and rollout. Coordinate delivery across engineers, mentor peers, and help shape the team’s roadmap.
Improve inference performance through production traces, load tests, and CPU/GPU profiling. Work with model owners to balance model quality, tail latency, throughput, and cost.
Partner with Compute on capacity, placement, and scaling, accounting for request complexity, cache state, GPU memory, and model startup behavior.
Build self-serve APIs and deployment workflows that manage models, runtime dependencies, features, and versioned state, with validation, safe rollout, and rollback.
Evaluate, integrate, and extend open source tools and vendor capabilities that advance model serving. Decide when to build or adopt, and collaborate with maintainers and vendors.
Own production reliability through service objectives, observability, on-call, incident response, and follow-through. Reduce recurring operational work through automation.
We’re excited about you because…
You have 6+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production infrastructure or distributed systems.
You have hands-on experience serving large or complex neural models online, with accountability for latency, availability, and resource efficiency.
You bring strong distributed systems fundamentals and proficiency in a backend or systems language such as Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, or C++.
You understand inference tradeoffs across batching, concurrency, caching, memory, and CPU/GPU utilization, and can diagnose production bottlenecks.
You have operated services on Kubernetes or comparable infrastructure, including resource configuration, autoscaling, and failure recovery.
You’ve led substantial projects through ambiguity, partnered with fast-moving ML or product teams, and helped other engineers grow.
You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience.

Experience integrating or extending inference tools such as Triton Inference Server or PyTorch.
Experience with multi-GPU inference, model parallelism, model-aware caching, or accelerator scheduling.

About the Team
People Product builds the internal products the People team runs on across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, including the surfaces and automated workflows for every employee support experience. About the Role
We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own products for the People team's human resources (HR) partner products. These products support the specialized HR and HR-adjacent teams  (e.g., Employee Relations) whose expertise the broader People team relies on to support employees. You'll work closely with them to discover the pain points that keep them from their highest-value work, apply product judgment to define the problems and the solutions that augment or automate high-cost workflows, and set a clear vision for where human judgment remains essential. Success is measured in cost, quality, and time for these teams, with experience standards as the floor.
You will report into the Senior Manager, People Product on our People Product team in our Technology, Insights & Operations organization.

Collaborate closely with Employee Relations specialists and People Business Partners in your first weeks, and come back with a clear diagnosis of the problems behind their requests.
Set the product vision and roadmap across the HR Partner team, and move People leaders at DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt from one-off requests to a shared plan they help set.

The Executive Assistant is the operational engine behind the President & CEO’s day. This person owns the calendar, travel and inbox so the President & CEO can focus on the highest priorities, and handles scheduling requests from across the company. The role also prepares itineraries for multi-day trips and events involving the President & CEO, and supports company events.
The role sits in the Office of the CEO team and reports to the Chief of Staff, while serving as executive assistant to the President & CEO. Because the role sees very sensitive information, discretion is essential.

Own President & CEO's calendar end-to-end — complex scheduling, prioritization, and proactive management of conflicts across multiple time zones
Anticipate scheduling needs before they arise; protect time for high-priority work and thinking
Prepare President & CEO for meetings with relevant context, briefings, and materials

Coordinate and manage complex meeting cadences across the Executive Leadership Team and extended leadership organization, including agenda preparation, pre-read distribution, and post-meeting action item tracking to ensure decisions are captured and followed through
Coordinate closely with the Chief of Staff to align on priorities and ensure nothing is missed
Travel Planning & Logistics
Plan and book complex domestic and international travel — flights, hotels, ground transport, visas — often on short notice with changing itineraries
Travel with President & CEO on select high-priority trips to provide on-the-ground support
Build detailed travel itineraries and anticipate logistics at every step
Manage travel expenses and reconcile reports accurately and on time
Meeting & Event Coordination
Coordinate executive leadership team meetings and offsites, including gathering agendas, logistics, and tracking follow-ups
Support All Hands meetings and company-wide events — managing AV, Zoom, run of show, and speaker coordination
Manage conference room calendars and troubleshoot tech issues in real time
Administrative & Special Projects
Maintain and update critical documentation, expense reports, and organizational records
Support confidential projects with the highest level of discretion
Assist with external relations, executive outreach, and stakeholder communications as needed
Take on special projects at the direction of President & CEO and the Chief of Staff

5+ years of executive assistant experience, ideally supporting a C-suite executive in a fast-paced tech or startup environment

Clear communicator, written and verbal, who can represent the President & CEO's voice when needed
Calm under pressure and decisive when priorities change
Comfortable managing up: keeps a busy executive on track without overstepping
Tech-driven: proficient with Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom and travel booking platforms, picks up new tools quickly, and uses AI to support and improve workflows

Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401K plan
Parental leave programs
Paid volunteer days
And much, much more!

The Opportunity
We are seeking a full-time Program Manager for Customer Support Strategy, based on-site at our DFW1 facility in Lewisville, TX. Your focus is reducing ticket volume, claims, and contra revenue, and improving the merchant experience. You will do this by improving support processes, ops processes, and engineering, by gathering merchant feedback (starting with NPS) and working cross-functionally to turn it into changes merchants feel, and by keeping content current and owning merchant communications. AI strategy and Zendesk optimization are key levers along the way.
Key Responsibilities
Program Ownership and Strategy:
Own omnichannel customer support programs from inception to execution, aligned to business goals and merchant needs.
Develop strategies with cross-functional teams, incorporating stakeholder feedback and industry best practices.
Drive implementation, overseeing timelines, resources, and budgets.
Ticket Reduction:
Analyze ticket data to find the top contact drivers, size them by volume, handle time, and cost, and build a prioritized reduction roadmap with clear targets.
Support processes: redesign workflows, macros, routing, and agent guidance so issues are resolved faster with fewer repeat contacts.
Ops processes: work with operations and site teams to fix the upstream breakdowns that create tickets, such as inbound, inventory, order, and billing issues.
Engineering: partner with engineering and product to prioritize and track the fixes and self-serve tools that remove root causes.
Merchant Experience and Feedback:
Own the feedback program, starting with NPS and adding other channels such as post-ticket surveys, agent and account manager input, ticket themes, and direct merchant conversations.
Analyze feedback themes and share insights with leadership and partners on a regular cadence.
Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations to apply feedback to the merchant’s actual experience, track changes to completion, and close the loop with merchants.
Claims and Contra Revenue Management:
Own the claims process end to end, including intake, investigation, resolution, and recovery from carriers and vendors where applicable.
Manage and improve contra revenue (credits, refunds, reimbursements, and adjustments) by setting policies, approval thresholds, and controls, and partnering with finance on accurate tracking and reporting.
Analyze claim and contra revenue drivers, and work with operations and engineering to fix root causes and reduce both over time.
Content and Merchant Communications:
Keep all support content current and managed (help center, knowledge base, macros, internal guides, process documentation), with clear owners and review cadences.
Own merchant communications, including notices, announcements, policy and process change letters, banners, and templates.

The Opportunity:
The global supply chain is one of the most heavily regulated industries for all parties involved.  Everyone from the carriers, intermediaries, trucking companies, 3rd party logistics, freight forwarders, shippers, consignees, importers, exporters, and brokers face a challenging and complex task of navigating through a myriad of laws from the originating country, destination country as well as international treaties and conventions.
The Trade Advisory team, consisting of business consultants, lawyers and licensed customs brokers, offers advanced customs and trade expertise to help clients identify supply chain risks and cost savings opportunities. We are looking for a Trade Advisory Associate - Entry Audit to join our Trade Advisory team. This team member will work closely with the Trade Advisory Lead to execute client entry audit projects, managing the day-to-day work associated with each engagement from data intake through final reporting and recommendations.
Audit scope: Entry audits review a client's historical import entries to validate compliance and uncover risk and savings opportunities. Scope typically includes tariff classification, customs valuation, country of origin, duty rates and special program eligibility (including free trade agreements and additional tariff programs), antidumping and countervailing duty exposure, and the accuracy of entry data filed in ACE. title: AI Software Engineer, Multimodal Agentic AI for Glasses
description:

Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
Our team is at the forefront of building the next generation of conversational AI. We are developing multimodal, agentic AI solutions for smart glasses, to create a unique, proactive, and trusted multimodal experience. This technology delivers instant, natural conversational intelligence directly to the user's eye and ear, allowing them to navigate and interact with their physical world more immersively than ever.
As a Senior AI Engineer, you will play a technical leadership role at the forefront of developing groundbreaking multimodal agentic AI solutions for smart glasses. You will architect and ship trusted, real-time conversational experiences that seamlessly blend voice, streaming vision, and physical-world context.

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI

contextually aware experiences.

description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
